Kod : 
Sub Makro1
	Set MTable = Doc.CreateTransactionalTableObject("MAKROTABLET=MMPS10T(NOFILE)", "IO")
	MTable.Addfield2 "SELECTED","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "KAYNAK_BIRIM","CHAR",6,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "MAMULADI","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	msgbox "x"
	Set S32E = Doc.GetTableObject("SFDC32E")
	S32E.Setd7FieldEvent "D7_AKSIYON","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "OncekiAcikOperasyonListesi"
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub OncekiAcikOperasyonListesi
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLET")
	Set S32E = Doc.GetTableObject("SFDC32E")
	
	MPSNo = Trim(S32E.MPSNO)
	AnaMPSNo = 	Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("MMPS10E", "ANAMPS", MPSNo, ""))
	IsNo = Trim(S32E.JOBNO)
	IsDurumu = Trim(S32E.D7_AKSIYON)
	OperasyonKodu = Trim(S32E.OPERASYON)
	OperasyonAdi = Trim(S32E.OPERASYON_IMLT01_AD)
	
	If IsDurumu = "E" Then
		Qstr = "SELECT "
		Qstr = Qstr &	" M10T.EVRAKNO"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" , M10T.R_MAMULKODU"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" , M10T.R_KAYNAKKODU"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" , M10T.R_OPERASYON"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" , M10T.R_TMYMAMULMIKTAR"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" , M10T.TRNUM"
				
		Qstr = Qstr &	" FROM"
		QStr = QStr & " MMPS10E M10E"
		QStr = QStr & " RIGHT JOIN" 
		QStr = QStr & " MMPS10T M10T"
		QStr = QStr & " ON M10E.EVRAKNO = M10T.EVRAKNO"
		
		If AnaMPSNo <> "" Then 
			QStr = QStr & " WHERE  Trim(M10E.ANAMPS)='"&AnaMPSNo&"'"
		Else
			QStr = QStr & " WHERE  Trim(M10E.ANAMPS)='"&MPSNo&"'"
		End If
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(M10E.ACIK_KAPALI) IS NULL"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(M10E.KAYNAKMPS)>='"&MPSNo&"'"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(M10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE) ='I' "
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(M10T.R_ACIK_KAPALI) IS NULL "
		'Qstr = Qstr &	" ORDER BY JOBNO"
	
		Set M10T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("TTRREE", Qstr) 
		
		KayitSayisi = M10T.GetRecCount
		
		If KayitSayisi > 0 Then
			MTable.Empty
			
			For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
				Filtered_MpsNo = Trim(M10T.EVRAKNO(i))
				Filtered_MamulKodu = Trim(M10T.R_MAMULKODU(i))
				Filtered_MamulAdi = Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", Filtered_MamulKodu, ""))
				Filtered_TezgahKodu = Trim(M10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i))
				Filtered_TezgahAdi = Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT00","AD",Filtered_TezgahKodu,""))
				Filtered_OperasyonKodu = Trim(M10T.R_OPERASYON(i))
				Filtered_OperasyonAdi = Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT01","AD",Filtered_OperasyonKodu,""))
				Filtered_TamamlananMiktar = Trim(M10T.R_TMYMAMULMIKTAR(i))
				Filtered_Birimi = Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", Filtered_MamulKodu, ""))
				Filtered_MPSTRNUM = Trim(M10T.TRNUM(i))
				
				SatirNo = MTable.AddRow
				MTable.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)

				MTable.EVRAKNO = Filtered_MpsNo
				MTable.R_MAMULKODU = Filtered_MamulKodu
				MTable.MAMULADI = Filtered_MamulAdi
				MTable.R_KAYNAKKODU = Filtered_TezgahKodu
				MTable.KAYNAK_AD = Filtered_TezgahAdi
				MTable.R_OPERASYON = Filtered_OperasyonKodu
				MTable.R_OPERASYON_IMLT01_AD = Filtered_OperasyonAdi
				MTable.R_TMYMAMULMIKTAR = Filtered_TamamlananMiktar
				MTable.KAYNAK_BIRIM = Filtered_Birimi
				MTable.TRNUM = Filtered_MPSTRNUM
			Next
			
			Dim Par
			Set Par=Nothing
			If Trim(Doc.GetCurrentForm("N")) <> "FORM_ONCEKI_ACIK_OPERASYONLAR" Then
				Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "FORM_ONCEKI_ACIK_OPERASYONLAR", SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, Par
			End If
			MTable.Refresh
		Else
			MTable.Empty
		End If
	End If
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub GeriDon
	Doc.RUN_APP_CANCEL
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub TumunuSecIptal
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLET")
	
	If MTable.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub
	If MTable.SELECTED(1) = "E" Then
		MTable.SELECTED(1) = "H"
	Else
		MTable.SELECTED(1) = "E"
	End if
	
	For i = 1 to MTable.GetRowCount
		MTable.SELECTED(i) = MTable.SELECTED(1)
	Next
	
	MTable.Refresh
	MTable.SetCurrentRow(1)
	'MTable.SafePack
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SeciliSatirOperasyonKapat
	Set MTableT = Doc.Select2G("YUHGFD", "MAKROTABLET", "SELECTED='E'&EVRAKNO<>''", "", "", -1)
	'MTableT.SafePack
	KayitSayisi = MTableT.GetRecCount
	
	If KayitSayisi = 0 Then 
		Msgbox "Kayýt Bulunamadý..."
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Seçili Satýrlardaki Operasyon Satýrlarý Kapatýlacak. Emin Misiniz?", "Dikkat", MB_YESNO)
	If k <> 6 Then Exit Sub
	
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("MMPS10", "")
	Set M10E = Doc1.GetTableObject("MMPS10E")
	Set M10T = Doc1.GetTableObject("MMPS10T")
	
	For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
		MpsEvrakNo = Trim(MTableT.EVRAKNO(i))
		MpsTRNUM = Trim(MTableT.TRNUM(i))
		OperasyonKodu = Trim(MTableT.R_OPERASYON(i))
		
		Doc1.Load_Voucher MpsEvrakNo
		DatabaseSatirSayisi = M10T.GetRecCount
		If DatabaseSatirSayisi = 0 Then Exit Sub
		
		For j = 1 To DatabaseSatirSayisi
			If Trim(M10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j)) = "I" Then
				Database_MpsTRNUM = Trim(M10T.TRNUM(j))
				Database_OperasyonKodu = Trim(M10T.R_OPERASYON(j))
				
				If MpsTRNUM = Database_MpsTRNUM Then
					If OperasyonKodu = Database_OperasyonKodu Then
						M10T.R_ACIK_KAPALI(j) = "K"
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next
		nret=Doc1.Save_Voucher
		Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
	Next
	
	Call OncekiAcikOperasyonListesi
	'Msgbox "Ýþlem Tamam..."
End Sub

Sub isbaslamabilgileri
	Dim Par
	Set Par=Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "ACIK_IS_BILGILERI", SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, Par

	Qstr = "SELECT * FROM SFDC32E"
	Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE  Trim(EVRAKNO) ='"&Trim(MTable.EVRAKNO)&"' "
	Set SF32E_2_2 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("10221V251a", Qstr) 
	If SF32E_2_2.GetRecCount = 0 Then Exit Sub
	
	'Bu ekranda TARIH2 ve TIME2 ters oldu. Yani baþlama tarih ve saat tanýmý 2 e atantý. 
	MTable.SFDC32_TARIH2 = SF32E_2_2.RECTARIH1(1)
	MTable.SFDC32_SAAT2 = Replace(SF32E_2_2.RECTIME1(1), ":", "")
	
	'ÖNCEKÝ ÝÞLERE AÝT BÝLGÝLERÝ TABLOYA DÖKER
	MTableT.Empty
	Qstr = "SELECT * FROM MMPS10T"
	Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE  Trim(EVRAKNO) ='"&Trim(MTable.MPSNO)&"' "
	Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  R_KAYNAKTYPE ='I' "
	Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(JOBNO) < '"& Trim(MTable.JOBNO) &"' "
	Qstr = Qstr &	" ORDER BY JOBNO DESC"

	Set M10T_11 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("25234655", Qstr) 

	If M10T_11.GetRowCount > 0 Then
		For i = 1 To M10T_11.GetRowCount
			SatirNo = MTableT.AddRow
			MTableT.SetCurrentRow(SatirNo)
			MTableT.JOBNO = Trim(M10T_11.JOBNO(i))
			MTableT.R_OPERASYON = Trim(M10T_11.R_OPERASYON(i))

			MTableT.TEZGAH	= Trim(M10T_11.R_KAYNAKKODU(i))
			TEZGAHADI = Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT00", "AD", Trim(MTableT.TEZGAH), ""))
			MTableT.TEZGAH_AD = TEZGAHADI
			MTableT.R_TMYMAMULMIKTAR = Trim(M10T_11.R_TMYMAMULMIKTAR(i))
		Next
		'MTableT.SafePack
	'Else
		'þayet kayýtsayýsý 0 ise bir önceki operasyon yok demektir.
		'baðlantýlý mps olsaydý alt mps in son operasyonunu getirmek gerekirdi.
		'þener bunu istemediðinden yapýlmadý.
		'GetOncekiOp = GetAltMPSSonOperasyon(M10TI, OpSatirNo)
	End If
	
	Qstr = "SELECT * FROM MMPS10T"
	Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE  Trim(EVRAKNO) ='"&Trim(MTable.MPSNO)&"' "
	Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  R_KAYNAKTYPE ='I' "
	Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(JOBNO) > '"& Trim(MTable.JOBNO) &"' "
	Qstr = Qstr &	" ORDER BY JOBNO ASC"

	Set M10T_22 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("27775655", Qstr) 	
	If M10T_22.GetRecCount > 0 Then
		SonrakiOperasyonKodu = Trim(M10T_22.R_OPERASYON(1))
		SonrakiOperasyonAdi = Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT01", "AD", SonrakiOperasyonKodu, ""))
		SonrakiOperasyonMiktari = Doc.NumFormat0(M10T_22.R_YMAMULMIKTAR(1), 20, 2)
		SonrakiOperasyonMiktarBirimi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", M10T_22.R_MAMULKODU(1), "")
		SonrakiOperasyonBilgileri = "Sonraki Operasyon Kodu = " & SonrakiOperasyonKodu & "," & vbcrlf & _
		"Adi = " & SonrakiOperasyonAdi & ", " & vbcrlf & _
		"Miktarý = " & SonrakiOperasyonMiktari & " " & SonrakiOperasyonMiktarBirimi
	Else
		SonrakiOperasyonBilgileri = "Bu Operasyon, Bu MPS' deki Son Operasyondur."
	End If
	MTable.SONRAKI_OPERASYON_BILGILERI = SonrakiOperasyonBilgileri	
End Sub

Sub isbaslamatarihiniissonlandirmatarihine_aktar
	Doc.RUN_APP_EXIT_ONIDLE
	'bu butonda iþlem ters oldu. tarih bitiþ tarihi, 2 ise iþin baþlama tarihi olarak alýndý.
	MTable.SFDC32_TARIH = MTable.SFDC32_TARIH2
End Sub

Sub secilenisbilgilerinigetir
	Nereden = "COKLULISTEDEN" 
	EvrakNo = Trim(MTableO2.CBENO)
	If EvrakNo = "" Then Exit Sub
	Call EskiBilgileriEkranaGetir(EvrakNo)
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Makro1()
	'Doc.SetMesajlarDosyaya(TRUE)
	Set WshShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
	strCurDir = WshShell.CurrentDirectory
	CurrentDriveLetter = Left(Trim(strCurDir), 1)

	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	Set dc = fso.Drives
	For Each d In dc
		If Trim(d.DriveLetter) =  CurrentDriveLetter Then
			SeriNo = "4625E0C1"   'þener:4625E0C1
			DiscSerialNo = Hex(d.SerialNUmber)
			If SeriNo <> DiscSerialNo Then
				Msgbox "Lisans Problemi." & vbcrlf & "www.minmaks.com" & vbcrlf & "0532 231 64 25"
				'Doc.RUN_APP_EXIT_ONIDLE
			End If
		End If
	Next
	Set Fso=Nothing
	
	Set STACK_PDA=Doc.CreateTableObject("STACK_PDA=STACK","IO")  
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "PROPT","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "DURUS","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "ESKIMI","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "FIRE_MAMUL_HMADDE","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "ARAKAYIT_ISBITTI","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "TUKETIMSECENEKLERI","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "BILGISATIRIE","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""	
	Set STOK01_PDA=Doc.CreateTableObject("STOK01_PDA=STOK01(NOFILE)","IO")

	Set MTable=Doc.CreateTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF=STACK","IO")
	MTable.Addfield2 "BARKOD","CHAR",30,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "BARKODKALIP","CHAR",30,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "BARKODOPERATOR","CHAR",30,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "BARKODDURUS","CHAR",30,0,"L","",""

Sub Makro1()
	HedefFirma = "KABLO_2014"
	Uygulama = Doc.GetDocType0
	Grid = Doc.GetGUIControl_Table
	TabInfo = Doc.GetCurrentTabInfo()
	TabAdi = TabInfo(0)
	CODE3 = Left(trim(Grid) & "/" & TabAdi & Space(20), 20)
	if trim(CODE3) = "" Then Exit Sub
	
	DeleteQStr = "DELETE FROM " & HedefFirma & ".STRPAR2"
	DeleteQStr = DeleteQStr & " WHERE CODE2='" & Uygulama & "'"
	DeleteQStr = DeleteQStr & " AND CODE3='" & CODE3 & "'"
	DeleteQStr = DeleteQStr & " AND USER_1='*'"
	Set gg = Doc.RunMacro1("MAKR7S.RUNSQL", "RunSQLQuery2", DeleteQStr)

	InsertQStr = "INSERT INTO " & HedefFirma & ".STRPAR2"
	InsertQStr = InsertQStr & " SELECT * FROM STRPAR2"
	InsertQStr = InsertQStr & " WHERE CODE2='" & Uygulama & "'"
	InsertQStr = InsertQStr & " AND CODE3='" & CODE3 & "'"
	InsertQStr = InsertQStr & " AND USER_1='*'"
	Set gg = Doc.RunMacro1("MAKR7S.RUNSQL", "RunSQLQuery2", InsertQStr)
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	Call FirmadanFirmayaDocCopyAll("TESTK_2014")
	'Call EkrandakiEvrakiBaskaFirmayaKopyala("TESTK_2014")
End Sub
Sub FirmadanFirmayaDocCopyAll(TargetFirm)
	Call FirmadanFirmayaDocCopy(TargetFirm, "MAKR7S")
	Call FirmadanFirmayaDocCopy(TargetFirm, "MAKR8S")
	Call FirmadanFirmayaDocCopy(TargetFirm, "PFRM7S")
	Call FirmadanFirmayaDocCopy(TargetFirm, "GECO10")
	Call FirmadanFirmayaDocCopy(TargetFirm, "GDEF00")
End Sub
Sub FirmadanFirmayaDocCopy(TargetFirm, DocTypeStr)
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI(DocTypeStr, "")
	Set Doc2 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI2(DocTypeStr, "", TargetFirm)

	DocArray = GetDocList(DocTypeStr)
	For each DocNo in DocArray
		Doc.StatusBarMessage DocTypeStr & " : " & DocNo
		if trim(DocNo) <> "" Then
			Doc1.Load_Voucher DocNo
			if Doc1.GetLastLoadType <> "N" Then
				Doc1.RunCommand "MT_DOC_COPY"

				Doc2.Load_Voucher DocNo
				Doc2.RunCommand "MT_DOC_PASTE"
				Doc2.Save_Voucher
			End if
			Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
			Doc2.LoadEmpty_Voucher
		End if
	Next
End Sub
Function GetDocList(DocType)
	if DocType = "MAKR7S" Then
		GetDocList = GetMakroList()
	Elseif DocType = "PFRM7S" Then
		GetDocList = GetFormList()
	Elseif DocType = "MAKR8S" Then
		GetDocList = GetEventMakroList()
	Elseif DocType = "GECO10" Then
		GetDocList = GetGecoList()
	Elseif DocType = "GDEF00" Then
		GetDocList = GetDepoList()
	Else
		GetDocList = Array("")
	End if
End Function
Function GetFormList()
	GetFormList = Array("ETK-HMD", "ISLIST")
End Function
Function GetMakroList()
	GetMakroList = Array("_GNPRGHM1", "_GNPRGMPS3", "_GNPRGSF1", "STOK20","_GNPRGPLN3")
End Function
Function GetEventMakroList()
	GetEventMakroList = Array("STOK20")
End Function
Function GetGecoList()
	GetGecoList = Array("!HM_URT_TP","I00GK1","STKGK2","SFDC20SEBP")
End Function
Function GetDepoList()
	GetDepoList = Array("IM")
End Function
Sub EkrandakiEvrakiBaskaFirmayaKopyala(TargetFirm)
	DocNo = Doc.GetLoadedVoucher
	if trim(DocNo) = "" Then Exit Sub
	
	if Doc.GetDocType0 = "UDEF00" Then
    Set GENDOC = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("DOCUMENT","")
    GENDOC.Set_Security_Option "UDEF00_SECURITY","NO","",""
    Set Doc2 = GENDOC.CreateDocumentNoUI2("UDEF00","", TargetFirm)
	Else
		Set Doc2 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI2(Doc.GetDocType0, "", TargetFirm)
	End if
	
	Doc.RunCommand "MT_DOC_COPY"

	Doc2.Load_Voucher DocNo
	Doc2.RunCommand "MT_DOC_PASTE"
	Doc2.Save_Voucher

	Doc2.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub

Function RunSQLQuery2(QStr)
	Set Oconn = CreateFirmaOLEDBConnection()
	Oconn.Open

	Set cmd = CreateObject("ADODB.Command")
	Set cmd.ActiveConnection = Oconn
		
	cmd.CommandText = QStr

	Set RunSQLQuery2 = cmd.Execute(, , adExecuteNoRecords)
	Set cmd = Nothing
	Oconn.Close
End Function
Function CreateFirmaOLEDBConnection()
	Set Oconn = CreateObject("ADODB.Connection")
	cnnStr = GetFirmaOLEDBConnectionStr()
	Oconn.ConnectionString = cnnStr
	Set CreateFirmaOLEDBConnection = Oconn
End Function
Function GetFirmaOLEDBConnectionStr()
	GetFirmaOLEDBConnectionStr = ""

	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	if Doc.IsSQL Then
		ConnStrHeader = "ConnectionString="
		Dosya = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & "\Entprd.ini"
	Else
		Dosya = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataRoot() & "\freedom.ini"
		ConnStrHeader = "DefaultConnectionString="
	End if
	If Not fso.FileExists(Dosya) Then Exit Function

	Set TFile = fso.OpenTextFile(Dosya, 1)
	SettingsBulundu = False
	While Not TFile.AtEndOfStream
		satirStr = TFile.ReadLine
		If UCase(Trim(satirStr)) = "[SETTINGS]" Then
			SettingsBulundu = True
		End If
		If SettingsBulundu And InStr(1, satirStr, ConnStrHeader) = 1 Then
			ConnStr = Mid(satirStr, Len(ConnStrHeader) + 1)
			if Doc.IsSQL Then
		    	FirmaDonem = Doc.Getd7FirmCode
		    	Arr1 = Split(FirmaDonem, "_")
				if uBound(Arr1) = 1 Then
		     	Firma = LCase(Arr1(0))
     			Donem = Arr1(1)
					ConnStr = Replace(ConnStr, "@@@FIRMA@@@", Firma)
					ConnStr = Replace(ConnStr, "@@@DONEM@@@", Donem)
				End if
			Else
				ConnStr = Replace(ConnStr, "@@@DBNAME@@@", Doc.Getd7FirmCode)
			End if
		End If
	Wend
	GetFirmaOLEDBConnectionStr = ConnStr
End Function

Sub isbaslamabilgileri
	Dim Par
	Set Par=Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "ACIK_IS_BILGILERI", SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, Par

	Qstr = "SELECT * FROM SFDC32E"
	Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE  Trim(EVRAKNO) ='"&Trim(MTable.EVRAKNO)&"' "
	Set SF32E_2_2 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("10221V251a", Qstr) 
	If SF32E_2_2.GetRecCount = 0 Then Exit Sub
	
	'Bu ekranda TARIH2 ve TIME2 ters oldu. Yani baþlama tarih ve saat tanýmý 2 e atantý. 
	MTable.SFDC32_TARIH2 = SF32E_2_2.RECTARIH1(1)
	MTable.SFDC32_SAAT2 = Replace(SF32E_2_2.RECTIME1(1), ":", "")
	
	'ÖNCEKÝ ÝÞLERE AÝT BÝLGÝLERÝ TABLOYA DÖKER
	MTableT.Empty
	Qstr = "SELECT * FROM MMPS10T"
	Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE  Trim(EVRAKNO) ='"&Trim(MTable.MPSNO)&"' "
	Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  R_KAYNAKTYPE ='I' "
	Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(JOBNO) < '"& Trim(MTable.JOBNO) &"' "
	Qstr = Qstr &	" ORDER BY JOBNO DESC"

	Set M10T_11 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("25234655", Qstr) 

	If M10T_11.GetRowCount > 0 Then
		For i = 1 To M10T_11.GetRowCount
			SatirNo = MTableT.AddRow
			MTableT.SetCurrentRow(SatirNo)
			MTableT.JOBNO = Trim(M10T_11.JOBNO(i))
			MTableT.R_OPERASYON = Trim(M10T_11.R_OPERASYON(i))

			MTableT.TEZGAH	= Trim(M10T_11.R_KAYNAKKODU(i))
			TEZGAHADI = Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT00", "AD", Trim(MTableT.TEZGAH), ""))
			MTableT.TEZGAH_AD = TEZGAHADI
			MTableT.R_TMYMAMULMIKTAR = Trim(M10T_11.R_TMYMAMULMIKTAR(i))
		Next
		'MTableT.SafePack
	'Else
		'þayet kayýtsayýsý 0 ise bir önceki operasyon yok demektir.
		'baðlantýlý mps olsaydý alt mps in son operasyonunu getirmek gerekirdi.
		'þener bunu istemediðinden yapýlmadý.
		'GetOncekiOp = GetAltMPSSonOperasyon(M10TI, OpSatirNo)
	End If
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	'Doc.SetMesajlarDosyaya(TRUE)
	Set WshShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
	strCurDir = WshShell.CurrentDirectory
	CurrentDriveLetter = Left(Trim(strCurDir), 1)

	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	Set dc = fso.Drives
	For Each d In dc
		If Trim(d.DriveLetter) =  CurrentDriveLetter Then
			SeriNo = "4625E0C1"   'þener:4625E0C1
			DiscSerialNo = Hex(d.SerialNUmber)
			If SeriNo <> DiscSerialNo Then
				Msgbox "Lisans Problemi." & vbcrlf & "www.minmaks.com"
				'Doc.RUN_APP_EXIT_ONIDLE
			End If
		End If
	Next
	Set Fso=Nothing
	
	Set STACK_PDA=Doc.CreateTableObject("STACK_PDA=STACK","IO")  
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "PROPT","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "DURUS","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "ESKIMI","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "FIRE_MAMUL_HMADDE","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "ARAKAYIT_ISBITTI","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "TUKETIMSECENEKLERI","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "BILGISATIRIE","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""	
	Set STOK01_PDA=Doc.CreateTableObject("STOK01_PDA=STOK01(NOFILE)","IO")

	Set MTable=Doc.CreateTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF=STACK","IO")

Sub Makro1()
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("SFDC32", "")
	Set Doc2 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("D7KIDSLB", "")

	Set STACK_PDA=Doc.CreateTableObject("STACK_PDA=STACK","IO")
	STACK_PDA.Addfield2 "PROPT","CHAR",1,0,"L","",""

	Set STOK01_PDA=Doc.CreateTableObject("STOK01_PDA=STOK01(NOFILE)","IO")
	STOK01_PDA.Addfield2 "PRX_LOCATION1","CHAR",2,0,"L","",""
	STOK01_PDA.Addfield2 "PRX_LOCATION2","CHAR",2,0,"L","",""
	STOK01_PDA.Addfield2 "PRX_LOCATION3","CHAR",2,0,"L","",""
	STOK01_PDA.Addfield2 "PRX_LOCATION4","CHAR",2,0,"L","",""
	STOK01_PDA.Addfield2 "SF_PAKETICERIGI","DOUBLE",12,0,"R","",""
	STOK01_PDA.Addfield2 "SF_MIKTAR_KALAN","DOUBLE",12,3,"R","",""
	STOK01_PDA.Addfield2 "SAYAC","DOUBLE",12,0,"R","",""

	Set MTable=Doc.CreateTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF=STACK","IO")
	MTable.Addfield2 "BARKOD","CHAR",30,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "MPSNO","CHAR",10,0,"R","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "MPSTM_TRNUM","CHAR",6,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "OPERASYON","CHAR",6,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "OPERASYON_AD","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "TEZGAH","CHAR",24,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "TEZGAH_AD","CHAR",50,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "JOBNO","CHAR",16,0,"R","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "SFDC32_EVRAKNO","CHAR",10,0,"R","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "SFDC32T_TRNUM","CHAR",6,0,"L","",""

	MTable.Setd7FieldEvent "BARKOD","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "BARKOD_AV"

Sub BARKOD_AV()
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF")
	Set STACK_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STACK_PDA")
	Set STOK01_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK01_PDA")
	Set MTableT = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLET_STACK")

	Barkod = MTable.BARKOD
	if trim(Barkod) = "" Then Exit Sub
	if Left(Barkod, 4) <> "%JB%" Then 
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Okutulan Barkod operasyon barkodu deðil", "", MB_OK
		MTable.BARKOD = ""
		STOK01_PDA.SAYAC = MTableT.GetRowCount()
		Exit Sub		
	End if

	IsNo = Doc.RightJustify(Mid(trim(Barkod), 5), 16)
	Set M10T = Doc.Select1("sdfwgsdg", "MMPS10T", "JOBNO='" & IsNo & "'", "", -1)
	if M10T.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox d7LB.JOBNO & " no.lu iþ geçersiz", "", MB_OK
		MTable.BARKOD = ""
		STOK01_PDA.SAYAC = MTableT.GetRowCount()
		Exit Sub		
	End if

'	if trim(STACK_PDA.PROPT) = "1" Then
		Call StokBilgileriniDoldur(IsNo)
'	End if
	MTable.BARKOD = ""
	STOK01_PDA.SAYAC = MTableT.GetRowCount()	
End Sub
Sub MiktariSifirla()
	Set STOK01_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK01_PDA")
	STOK01_PDA.SF_PAKETICERIGI = 0
End Sub
Sub EkleCikar()
	Set STACK_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STACK_PDA")
	if trim(STACK_PDA.PROPT) = "1" Then
		Call Ekle()
	Else
		Call Cikar()
	End if
End Sub
Sub Ekle()
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF")
	Set MTableT = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLET_STACK")
	Set STOK01_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK01_PDA")

	if trim(STOK01_PDA.KOD) = "" Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Okutma yapýlmamýþ", "Ýþlem kesildi", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if

	if STOK01_PDA.SF_PAKETICERIGI = 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Miktar girmelisiniz", "Ýþlem kesildi", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if
'	Call CalcOpMiktar(MTable.MPSNO, MTable.JOBNO, BuOpToplamMiktar, OncekiOpMiktar)
	'msgbox BuOpToplamMiktar & ", " & OncekiOpMiktar
'	if BuOpToplamMiktar > OncekiOpMiktar and OncekiOpMiktar <> -1 Then
'		Doc.d7MsgBox "Önceki Operasyonun Tamamlanan Miktarý  :" & OncekiOpMiktar & vbcrlf & "Bu operasyonun Tamamlanan miktarý : " & BuOpToplamMiktar & vbcrlf & "giriþ yapýlamaz", "Ýþlem kesildi", MB_OK
'		Exit Sub		
'	End if

	satirNo = MTableT.AddRow()
	MTableT.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)

	S01Arr = Array("KOD", "LOTNUMBER", "SERINO", "LOCATION1", "LOCATION2", "LOCATION3", "LOCATION4", "FOKOD", _
					"VRI_VR_RC", "VRI_VR_R1", "VRI_VR_R2", "VRI_VR_R3", "VRI_NUM1", "VRI_NUM2", "SF_UNIT", "AMBCODE", _
					"ALLOC_SYSSTATUS", "ALLOC_EVRAKTYPE", "ALLOC_EVRAKNO", "ALLOC_SIPTYPE", "ALLOC_SIPNO", "ALLOC_SIPARTNO", _
					"ALLOC_MPSEVNO", "ALLOC_MPSARTNO", "STOK03_ID")

	For each Alan in S01Arr
		AlanDegeri = STOK01_PDA.GetFieldValue(Alan, -1)
		MTableT.SetFieldValue Alan, -1, AlanDegeri
	Next
	MTableT.SF_MIKTAR = STOK01_PDA.SF_PAKETICERIGI

	MTableT.MPSNO = MTable.MPSNO
	MTableT.MPSTM_TRNUM = MTable.MPSTM_TRNUM
	MTableT.OPERASYON = MTable.OPERASYON
	MTableT.TEZGAH = MTable.TEZGAH
	MTableT.JOBNO = MTable.JOBNO

	STOK01_PDA.Empty
	STOK01_PDA.SAYAC = MTableT.GetRowCount()
End Sub
Sub Cikar()
	Set STOK01_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK01_PDA")
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF")
	Set STACK_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STACK_PDA")
	Set MTableT = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLET_STACK")

	if STOK01_PDA.SF_PAKETICERIGI = 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Miktar girmelisiniz", "Ýþlem kesildi", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if

	IsNo = MTable.JOBNO
	Set S01 = Doc.Select2("sdf23fsdf", "MAKROTABLET_STACK", "JOBNO='" & IsNo & "'", "", -1)
	if S01.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Bu barkod daha önce okutulmamýþ", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
	Else
		if S01.SumOf("SF_MIKTAR") < STOK01_PDA.SF_PAKETICERIGI Then
			Doc.d7MsgBox "Daha önce okutulan miktardan fazla çýkýlamaz", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
			STOK01_PDA.Empty
			STOK01_PDA.SAYAC = MTableT.GetRowCount()
			Exit Sub
		End if
		KalanMiktar = STOK01_PDA.SF_PAKETICERIGI
		For i = 1 to MTableT.GetRowCount()
			if trim(MTableT.JOBNO(i)) = trim(IsNo) Then
				if KalanMiktar <= MTableT.SF_MIKTAR(i) Then
					CikilacakMiktar = KalanMiktar
				Else
					CikilacakMiktar = MTableT.SF_MIKTAR(i)
				End if
				MTableT.SF_MIKTAR(i) = MTableT.SF_MIKTAR(i) - CikilacakMiktar
				if MTableT.SF_MIKTAR(i) = 0 Then
					MTableT.KOD(i) = ""
					MTableT.SF_UNIT(i) = ""
				End if
				KalanMiktar = KalanMiktar - CikilacakMiktar
				if KalanMiktar = 0 Then Exit For
			End if
		Next
		MTableT.SafePack()
	End if
	STOK01_PDA.Empty
	STOK01_PDA.SAYAC = MTableT.GetRowCount()
End Sub
Sub StokBilgileriniDoldur(IsNo)
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF")
	Set STOK01_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK01_PDA")
	Barkod = MTable.BARKOD
	MTable.SetFieldValueNV "BARKOD", -1, ""

	STOK01_PDA.Empty
	Set M10T = Doc.Select1("sdfwgsdg", "MMPS10T", "JOBNO='" & IsNo & "'", "", -1)
	Set M10TM = Doc.Select1("sddddfwgsdg", "MMPS10TM", "EVRAKNO='" & M10T.EVRAKNO & "'", "", -1)
	
	STOK01_PDA.KOD= M10T.R_MAMULKODU
	STOK01_PDA.KOD_STOK00_AD= Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", STOK01_PDA.KOD, "")
	STOK01_PDA.SF_UNIT = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("MMPS10E", "SF_SF_UNIT", M10T.EVRAKNO, "")

	MTable.MPSNO = M10T.EVRAKNO
	MTable.MPSTM_TRNUM = M10TM.TRNUM
	MTable.JOBNO = IsNo
	MTable.OPERASYON = M10T.R_OPERASYON
	MTable.OPERASYON_AD = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT01", "AD", M10T.R_OPERASYON, "")
	MTable.TEZGAH = M10T.R_KAYNAKKODU
	MTable.TEZGAH_AD = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("IMLT00", "AD", M10T.R_KAYNAKKODU , "")

	STOK01_PDA.SF_PAKETICERIGI = 0
End Sub
Sub AlanDepoveLokasyonBilgileriniDodur()
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF")
	Barkod = 	MTable.BARKOD
	MTable.BARKOD = ""

	if Doc.IsBlank(STOK01_PDA) Then Set STOK01_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK01_PDA")

	LocPrefix = trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("LOCPREFX"))
	Lokasyon = Mid(Barkod, Len(LocPrefix) + 1)

	if trim(Lokasyon) = "" Then Exit Sub

	LocSpace = trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("LOCSPACE"))
	if LocSpace = "" Then Exit Sub

	LokArray = Split(Lokasyon, LocSpace)
	if uBound(LokArray) < 3 Then Exit Sub
	if uBound(LokArray) = 3 and trim(LokArray(0)) = "" Then Exit Sub

	if uBound(LokArray) = 4 Then
		MTable.TARGETAMBCODE = LokArray(4)
	Else
		QStr = "LOCATION1='" & LokArray(0) & "'&LOCATION2='" & LokArray(1) & "'&LOCATION3='" & LokArray(2) & "'&LOCATION4='" & LokArray(3) & "'"
		Set S69T = Doc.Select1("f23fsdf3", "STOK69T", QStr, "", -1)
		if S69T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
			MTable.TARGETAMBCODE = S69T.AMBCODE
		End if
	End if
	STOK01_PDA.PRX_LOCATION1 = LokArray(0)
	STOK01_PDA.PRX_LOCATION2 = LokArray(1)
	STOK01_PDA.PRX_LOCATION3 = LokArray(2)
	STOK01_PDA.PRX_LOCATION4 = LokArray(3)
End Sub
Sub EkraniTemizle()
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF")
	Set MTableT = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLET_STACK")
	Set STOK01_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK01_PDA")
	
	MTable.Empty
	STOK01_PDA.Empty
	MTableT.Empty
End Sub
Sub SonIslemIptal()
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF")
'	MTable.SFDC32_EVRAKNO = SFDC32EvrakNo
'	MTable.SFDC32T_TRNUM = SFDC32T_TRNum

	if trim(MTable.SFDC32_EVRAKNO) = "" or trim(MTable.SFDC32T_TRNUM) = "" Then Exit Sub

	if UretimFisiniSil(MTable.SFDC32_EVRAKNO, MTable.SFDC32T_TRNUM) <> 0 Then Exit Sub

	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("SFDC32", "")
	Set SFDC32T = Doc1.GettableObject("SFDC32T")
	Doc1.Load_Voucher MTable.SFDC32_EVRAKNO
	if SFDC32T.GetRowCount() = 1 Then
		if trim(SFDC32T.TRNUM) = trim(MTable.SFDC32T_TRNUM) Then
			if Doc1.Delete_Voucher = 0 Then
				Doc.d7MsgBox trim(MTable.SFDC32_EVRAKNO) & " no.lu Çalýþma Bildirimi iptal edildi", "Ýþlem Tamam", MB_OK
				MTable.Empty
			End if
		Else
			Doc.d7MsgBox trim(MTable.SFDC32_EVRAKNO) & " no.lu çalýþma bildiriminde " & vbcrlf & _
								trim(MTable.SFDC32T_TRNUM) & " no.lu satýr bulunamadý", "Ýþlem Ýptal", MB_OK
			MTable.Empty		
		End if
	Else
		Silindi = False
		For i = 1 to SFDC32T.GetRowCount()
			if trim(SFDC32T.TRNUM(i)) = trim(MTable.SFDC32T_TRNUM) Then
				SFDC32T.DeleteRowNoUI i
				Silindi = True
			End if
		Next
		if Silindi Then
			if Doc1.Save_Voucher = 0 Then
				Doc.d7MsgBox trim(MTable.SFDC32_EVRAKNO) & " no.lu Çalýþma Bildirimi kaydedildi.", "Ýþlem Tamam", MB_OK
				MTable.Empty
			End if
		Else
			Doc.d7MsgBox trim(MTable.SFDC32_EVRAKNO) & " no.lu çalýþma bildiriminde " & vbcrlf & _
								trim(MTable.SFDC32T_TRNUM) & " no.lu satýr bulunamadý", "Ýþlem Ýptal", MB_OK
			MTable.Empty		
		End if
	End if
End Sub
Sub CalismaBildirimiOlustur()
	Set STOK01_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK01_PDA")
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF")
	Set MTableT1 = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLET_STACK")
	Set MTableT = Doc.Select2("sdsdfsdf", "MAKROTABLET_STACK", "", "JOBNO", -1)

	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("SFDC32", "")
	Set SFDC32E = Doc1.GetTableObject("SFDC32E")
	Set SFDC32T = Doc1.GetTableObject("SFDC32T")

	For i = 1 to MTableT.GetRowCount()
		if MTableT.JOBNO(i) <> EskiIsNo Then
			Call CalismaBildiriminiKaydet(Doc1)
			Doc1.New_Voucher()
			SFDC32E.MPSNO = MTableT.MPSNO(i)
			SFDC32E.JOBNO = MTableT.JOBNO(i)
		End if
		EskiIsNo = MTableT.JOBNO(i)

		if SFDC32T.GetRowCount() = 1 and SFDC32T.SF_MIKTAR = 0 Then
			satirNo = 1
		Else
			satirNo = SFDC32T.AddRow()
		End if
		SFDC32T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)

		SFDC32T.MPSTM_TRNUM = MTableT.MPSTM_TRNUM(i)
		SFDC32T.LOTNUMBER = MTableT.LOTNUMBER(i)
		SFDC32T.SERINO = MTableT.SERINO(i)
		SFDC32T.SF_MIKTAR = MTableT.SF_MIKTAR(i)
	Next
	Call CalismaBildiriminiKaydet(Doc1)

	MTable.Empty
	STOK01_PDA.Empty
	MTableT1.Empty
End Sub
Sub CalismaBildiriminiKaydet(Doc1)
	Set SFDC32E = Doc1.GetTableObject("SFDC32E")
	Set SFDC32T = Doc1.GetTableObject("SFDC32T")

	if trim(SFDC32E.EVRAKNO) = "" Then Exit Sub

	For i = 1 to SFDC32T.GetRowCount()
		if trim(SFDC32T.SF_MIKTAR(i)) = 0 Then
			SFDC32T.KOD(i) = ""
			SFDC32T.MPSTM_TRNUM(i) = ""
			SFDC32T.SF_SF_UNIT(i) = ""
			SFDC32T.RECETEKOD(i) = ""
		End if
	Next
	SFDC32E.SF_MIKTAR = SFDC32T.SumOf("SF_MIKTAR")
	Doc1.RunCommand "CMD_SURE_KAYITLARI"
	ret = Doc1.Save_Voucher
	if ret = 0 Then 
'		Call EtiketleriGuncelle(SFDC32T)
		Call SonOpIseUretimFisiKes(Doc1, SFDC32E.MPSNO, SFDC32E.JOBNO)
	Else
		Doc.d7MsgBox trim(SFDC32E.EVRAKNO) & " no.lu çalýþma bildirimi kaydedilemedi", "Ýþlem Tamamlandý", MB_OK
	End if
	Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub
Sub EtiketYazdir()
	exit sub
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE_SF")
	TREvrakNo = MTable.STOK25_EVRAKNO
	if trim(TREvrakNo) = "" Then Exit Sub
	if trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK25E", "EVRAKNO", MTable.STOK25_EVRAKNO, "")) = "" Then Exit Sub
	
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK25", "")
	Doc1.Load_Voucher MTable.STOK25_EVRAKNO
	Set S25T = Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK25T")
	if S25T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		Set D7LB = Doc.Select1("sdfw4fsdgf", "D7KIDSLB", "KOD='" & Doc.LeftJustify(trim(S25T.NEWSERINO(1)),30) & "'", "", -1)
		if D7LB.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
			EtiketFormKodu = D7LB.FORMKODU
			Doc1.RunMacro0 "PFRM7S." & EtiketFormKodu, "PrintLabel"
		End if
	End if
	Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub
Sub SonOpIseUretimFisiKes(Doc1, MPSNo, IsNo)
	if Not SonOpMu(MPSNo, IsNo) Then Exit Sub

	Set SFDC32E = Doc1.GetTableObject("SFDC32E")
	Set SFDC32T = Doc1.GetTableObject("SFDC32T")

	SFDC32T.SafePack()
	if SFDC32T.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub

	Set Doc2 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK20", "")
	Set STOK20E = Doc2.GetTableObject("STOK20E")
	Set STOK20T = Doc2.GetTableObject("STOK20T")


	Doc2.New_Voucher

	if left(SFDC32T.KOD(1),3) = "AOS" or left(SFDC32T.KOD(1),3) = "HTT" or left(SFDC32T.KOD(1),3) = "FKS" then
		STOK20E.AMBCODE = "0"
	else
		STOK20E.AMBCODE = "IM"
	End if

	STOK20E.IMALATAMBCODE = "IM"
	STOK20E.YANMAMULAMBCODE = "IM"
	
	For i = 1 to SFDC32T.GetRowCount()
		satirNo = STOK20T.AddRow()
		STOK20T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
		STOK20T.MPSNO = SFDC32E.MPSNO
		STOK20T.MPSTM_TRNUM = SFDC32T.MPSTM_TRNUM(i)
		STOK20T.KOD = SFDC32T.KOD(i)
		STOK20T.LOTNUMBER = SFDC32T.LOTNUMBER(i)
		STOK20T.SERINO = SFDC32T.SERINO(i)
		STOK20T.SF_MIKTAR = SFDC32T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
		STOK20T.W_FIRMA = Doc1.Getd7FirmCode()
		STOK20T.W_APP = Doc1.GetDocType()
		STOK20T.W_TABLE = "SFDC32T"
		STOK20T.W_EVRAKTYPE = "S4"
		STOK20T.W_EVRAKNO = SFDC32E.EVRAKNO
		STOK20T.W_TRNUM = SFDC32T.TRNUM(i)
	Next
	Doc2.RunCommand "CMD_SIRALIK_ISLEM_003"
	Doc2.RunCommand "CMD_STOK01DEBULUNDUMU_BILGISATIRIE"
	Doc2.Save_Voucher
	Doc2.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub
Function SonOpMu(MPSNo, JobNo)
	SonOpMu = False
	SrNum = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("MMPS10T", "SRNUM", JobNo, "JOBNO")
	if trim(SrNum) = "" Then Exit Function

	Set M10T = Doc.Select1("f23f23sdgh", "MMPS10T", "EVRAKNO='" & MPSNo & "'&R_KAYNAKTYPE='I'&SRNUM>'" & SrNum & "'", "<SRNUM", -1)
	if M10T.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		SonOpMu = True
	End if
End Function
Function UretimFisiniSil(EvrakNo, TrNum)
	SeriNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("SFDC32T", "SERINO", EvrakNo & TrNum, "EVRAKNO+TRNUM")
	QStr = "W_EVRAKTYPE='S4'&W_EVRAKNO='" & EvrakNo & "'&W_TRNUM='" & TrNum & "'"
	Set S20T1 = Doc.Select1("sdfwegwhs", "STOK20T", QStr, "", -1)
	if S20T1.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		UretimFisiniSil = 0 
		Exit Function
	End if
	
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK20", "")
	Set S20T = Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK20T")
	Doc1.Load_Voucher S20T1.EVRAKNO(1)
	if S20T.GetRowCount() = 1 Then 
		UretimFisiniSil = Doc1.Delete_Voucher
		Exit Function
	Else
		For i = 1 to S20T.GetRowCount()
			if trim(S20T.SERINO(i)) = trim(SeriNo) Then
				S20T.DeleRowNoUI i
			End if
		Next
		UretimFisiniSil = Doc1.Save_Voucher
	End if
End Function
Sub EtiketleriGuncelle(SFDC32T)
	DocYaratildi = False
	For i = 1 to SFDC32T.GetRowCount()
		Barkod = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(SFDC32T.SERINO(i)), 30)
		Set d7LB = Doc.Select1("adf3efsdg", "D7KIDSLB", "KOD='" & Barkod & "'", "", -1)
		if d7LB.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
			if d7LB.SF_MIKTAR <> SFDC32T.SF_MIKTAR(i) Then
				if Not DocYaratildi Then
					Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("D7KIDSLB", "")
					Set d7LB1 = Doc1.GetTableObject("D7KIDSLB")
					DocYaratildi = True
				End if
				Doc1.Load_Voucher Barkod
				d7LB1.SF_MIKTAR = SFDC32T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
				Doc1.Save_Voucher
				Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
			End if
		End if
	Next
End Sub
Sub CalcOpMiktar(MPSNo, IsNo, BuOpTamamlananMiktar, OncekiOpTamamlananMiktar)
	SrNum = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("MMPS10T", "SRNUM", IsNo, "JOBNO")
	Set M10T = Doc.Select1("sd2g24sdfgdsg", "MMPS10T", "EVRAKNO='" & MPSNo & "'&R_KAYNAKTYPE='I'&SRNUM<'" & SrNum & "'", "<SRNUM", -1)
	Set STOK01_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK01_PDA")
	if M10T.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		OncekiOpTamamlananMiktar = -1
	Else
		OncekiOpTamamlananMiktar = M10T.R_TMYMAMULMIKTAR(1)
	End if
	
	Set MTableT = Doc.Select2("dfw34gsg", "MAKROTABLET_STACK", "JOBNO='" & IsNo & "'", "", -1)
	BuEvrakTamamlananMiktar = 0
	if MTableT.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		BuEvrakTamamlananMiktar = MTableT.SumOf("SF_MIKTAR")
	End if
	BuOpTamamlananMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("MMPS10T", "R_TMYMAMULMIKTAR", IsNo, "JOBNO") + BuEvrakTamamlananMiktar + _
						STOK01_PDA.SF_PAKETICERIGI
 End Sub

	Set STOK01_PDA = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK01_PDA")
	Set MTableT = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLET_STACK")
	STOK01_PDA.Empty
	MTableT.Empty

Sub Makro1()
	Set LISTEE = Doc.CreateTableObject("LISTEE=STACK", "IO")
	LISTEE.AddField2 "B_EVRAKNO", "CHAR", 10, 0, "R", "F2=DO_BRW('KTT_DBG0E')", ""
	LISTEE.AddField2 "E_EVRAKNO", "CHAR", 10, 0, "R", "F2=DO_BRW('KTT_DBG0E')", ""
	LISTEE.AddField2 "B_TARIH", "DATE", 10, 0, "L", "", ""
	LISTEE.AddField2 "E_TARIH", "DATE", 10, 0, "L", "", ""

	Set KTT_DBG0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DBG0T")
	KTT_DBG0T.Setd7FieldEvent "PERSKODU","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "PERSKODU_AV"

	Set LISTET = Doc.RunSQLQuery("LISTET", "SELECT EVRAKNO, TARIH, NOTES FROM KTT_DBG0E WHERE 1=0")

End Sub
Sub cmdSuz()
	Set LISTEE = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTEE")
	Set LISTET = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")

	QStr = "SELECT EVRAKNO, " & GetNorDateStr("TARIH") & ", NOTES "
	QStr = QStr & " FROM KTT_DBG0E"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE 1=1"
	QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH>='" & LISTEE.B_TARIH & "'"
	if trim(LISTEE.E_TARIH) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH<='" & LISTEE.E_TARIH & "'"
	End if
	QStr = QStr & " AND EVRAKNO>='" & LISTEE.B_EVRAKNO & "'"
	if trim(LISTEE.E_EVRAKNO) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND EVRAKNO<='" & LISTEE.E_EVRAKNO & "'"
	End if
	Set KT = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dfsdfhsj", QStr)
	LISTET.CopyTable(KT)
End Sub
Function GetNorDateStr(TarihFldName)
	GetNorDateStr = "TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(" & TarihFldName & ", 'YYYY/MM/DD'),'DD/MM/YYYY')"
End Function
Sub PERSKODU_AV()
	Set KTT_DBG0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_DBG0T")
	KTT_DBG0T.PERSADI = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("PERS00", "AD", KTT_DBG0T.PERSKODU, "")
End Sub
Sub cmdSec()
	Set LISTET = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")
	Doc.Load_Voucher LISTET.EVRAKNO
End Sub

Kod : 
Public AGradeProduction, BGradeProduction, CGrade, Loss, BaslangicTarihi, BitisTarihi, ReworkScheduled, ReworkUnscheduled

Sub Makro1()
	Set LISTEE = Doc.CreateTableObject("LISTEE=STACK", "IO")
	LISTEE.AddField2 "B_EVRAKNO", "CHAR", 10, 0, "R", "F2=DO_BRW('KTT_INDIS0E')", ""
	LISTEE.AddField2 "E_EVRAKNO", "CHAR", 10, 0, "R", "F2=DO_BRW('KTT_INDIS0E')", ""
	LISTEE.AddField2 "B_TARIH", "DATE", 10, 0, "L", "", ""
	LISTEE.AddField2 "E_TARIH", "DATE", 10, 0, "L", "", ""

	QStr1 = GetLISTETQStr1()
	QStr = Qstr1 & " WHERE 1=0"
	
	Set LISTET = Doc.RunSQLQuery("LISTET", QStr)

	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")
	KTT_INDIS0T.Setd7FieldEvent "INDISKODU","AFTERVALIDATE","MAKR7S." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, "INDISKODU_AV"
	
End Sub

Sub cmdRaporHazirla()
	Set ddddd = Doc.CreateSObject("BATCHERRORMODE")
	Set KTT_INDIS0E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0E")
	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")
	KTT_INDIS0T.Empty

	Set d7Date = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	BaslangicTarihi = KTT_INDIS0E.YIL & "/" & KTT_INDIS0E.AY & "/01"
	d7Date.SetDate BaslangicTarihi
	d7Date.AyinSonGununeGit
	BitisTarihi = d7Date.GetRevDate

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.GetCurrentRow
	
	Call AveBGradeUretimRaporuHazirla()
	Call NonMovingReportHesapla()
	Call InventoryDiffHesapla()
	Call CGradeRaporuHazirla()
	Call ABCToplamHesapla()
	Call LossHesapla()
	Call ReworkHesapla()
	Call YuzdeHesapla1()
	Call QualityClaimHesapla()
	Call NoOfIncomingQueriesHesapla()
	Call NoOfRepliedQueriesHesapla()
	Call NoOfNewProductHesapla()
	Call AverageResponseTimeHesapla()
	Call NoOfColorMatchingCorrectionHesapla()
	Call KazaRaporlariniHesapla()
	Call SpesificEnergyHesapla()
	Call ProdCostOku()			
	
	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")
	KTT_INDIS0T.Sort("INDISKODU")
	
	if KTT_INDIS0T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(1)
End Sub
Sub AveBGradeUretimRaporuHazirla()
	Set KTT_INDIS0E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0E")
	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")
	QStr = "SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T.SERINO LIKE 'A%' THEN SF_MIKTAR ELSE 0 END) A_GRADE_OUTPUT,"
	QStr = QStr & " SUM(CASE WHEN T.SERINO NOT LIKE 'A%' THEN SF_MIKTAR ELSE 0 END) B_GRADE_OUTPUT"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK20T T"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN GDEF00 G ON G.KOD=T.AMBCODE"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE T.TARIH>='" & BaslangicTarihi & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND T.TARIH<='" & BitisTarihi & "'"
	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND G.GK_1 IN ('01','04')"
	Else
		QStr = QStr & " AND G.GK_1='" & KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA & "'"
	End if
	QStr = QStr & " GROUP BY 1"
	
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "A ve B grade output raporu hazýrlanýyor : "
	Set S20T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfehaj", QStr)

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "01"
	if S20T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = S20T.A_GRADE_OUTPUT(1) / 1000
	
	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "06"
	if S20T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = S20T.B_GRADE_OUTPUT(1)

	if S20T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then 		
		AGradeProduction = S20T.A_GRADE_OUTPUT(1)
		BGradeProduction = S20T.B_GRADE_OUTPUT(1)
	End if
End Sub

Sub LossHesapla()
	Set KTT_INDIS0E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0E")
	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Loss Hesaplanýyor : "

	QStr = "SELECT SUM(INPUT) INPUT, SUM(OUTPUT) OUTPUT, SUM(NUMUNE) NUMUNE, SUM(FIRE) FIRE,"
	QStr = QStr & "  SUM(INPUT-OUTPUT-NUMUNE-FIRE) LOSS"
	QStr = QStr & "  FROM ("
	QStr = QStr & "  	SELECT SUM(SF_MIKTAR) OUTPUT, 0 INPUT, 0 NUMUNE, 0 FIRE"
	QStr = QStr & "  	FROM STOK20T T"
	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
		QStr = QStr & " WHERE T.AMBCODE IN (SELECT KOD FROM GDEF00 WHERE GK_1 IN ('01','04'))"
	Else
		QStr = QStr & " WHERE T.AMBCODE IN (SELECT KOD FROM GDEF00 WHERE GK_1='" & KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA & "')"
	End if
	QStr = QStr & " 	AND T.TARIH>='" & BaslangicTarihi & "' AND T.TARIH<='" & BitisTarihi & "'"
	QStr = QStr & "  	UNION ALL"
	QStr = QStr & "  	SELECT 0 OUTPUT, SUM(SF_MIKTAR) INPUT, 0 NUMUNE, 0 FIRE"
	QStr = QStr & "  	FROM STOK20TI T"
	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
		QStr = QStr & " WHERE T.AMBCODE IN (SELECT KOD FROM GDEF00 WHERE GK_1 IN ('01','04'))"
	Else
		QStr = QStr & " WHERE T.AMBCODE IN (SELECT KOD FROM GDEF00 WHERE GK_1='" & KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA & "')"
	End if
	QStr = QStr & " 	AND T.TARIH>='" & BaslangicTarihi & "' AND T.TARIH<='" & BitisTarihi & "'"
	QStr = QStr & "  	UNION ALL"
	QStr = QStr & "  	SELECT 0 OUTPUT, 0 INPUT, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(KTA.STD) IS NULL THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.15 END) NUMUNE, 0 FIRE"
	QStr = QStr & "  	FROM (SELECT T.KOD, T.EVRAKNO"
	QStr = QStr & "  	    FROM STOK20T T"
	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
		QStr = QStr & " WHERE T.AMBCODE IN (SELECT KOD FROM GDEF00 WHERE GK_1 IN ('01','04'))"
	Else
		QStr = QStr & " WHERE T.AMBCODE IN (SELECT KOD FROM GDEF00 WHERE GK_1='" & KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA & "')"
	End if
	QStr = QStr & " 		 AND T.TARIH>='" & BaslangicTarihi & "' AND T.TARIH<='" & BitisTarihi & "'"
	QStr = QStr & "  	    GROUP BY T.KOD,T.EVRAKNO"
	QStr = QStr & "  	  ) T"
	QStr = QStr & "  	  LEFT JOIN BOMU01E ON BOMU01E.MAMULCODE=T.KOD AND BOMU01E.AKTIF_PASIF='*'"
	QStr = QStr & "  	  LEFT JOIN KTA_BOMU01E KTA ON KTA.EVRAKNO=BOMU01E.EVRAKNO"
	QStr = QStr & "  	  UNION ALL"
	QStr = QStr & "  	  SELECT 0 OUTPUT, 0, 0 NUMUNE, Sum(SF_MIKTAR) FIRE"
	QStr = QStr & "  	  FROM STOK10A T"
	QStr = QStr & "  	  WHERE EVRAKTYPE='DT' AND T.KOD IN ('999999 02 02 003', '999999 02 02 002')"
	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND T.AMBCODE IN (SELECT KOD FROM GDEF00 WHERE GK_1 IN ('01','04'))"
	Else
		QStr = QStr & " AND T.AMBCODE IN (SELECT KOD FROM GDEF00 WHERE GK_1='" & KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA & "')"
	End if
	QStr = QStr & " 	  AND T.TARIH>='" & BaslangicTarihi & "' AND T.TARIH<='" & BitisTarihi & "'"
	QStr = QStr & "  	)"
	QStr = QStr & "  	GROUP BY 1"

	'Doc.d7MsgBox QStr, "", MB_OK

	Set S10A = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfsha", QStr)

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "09"
	if S10A.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = S10A.LOSS(1)
		Loss = S10A.LOSS(1)
	End if
End Sub
Sub ReworkHesapla()

	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")

	QStr = "SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN E.X_T_ISMERKEZI<> 'MARIS' AND E.RECTYPE IN ('DS','R') THEN KTA.INPUT-KTA.IADE ELSE 0 END) REWORK_SC,"

	QStr = Qstr & " FROM SFDC32E E"
	QStr = Qstr & " LEFT JOIN IMLT00 I ON I.KOD=E.X_T_ISMERKEZI"

	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "10"
	if S32E.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = S32E.REWORK_SC(1)
		ReworkScheduled = S32E.REWORK_SC(1)
 	End if

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "11"
	if S32E.GetRowCount() > 0 Then

	End if
End Sub

Sub QualityClaimHesapla()
	Set KTT_INDIS0E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0E")
	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")
	QStr = "SELECT STOK29T.EVRAKNO FROM STOK29T"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN GDEF00 G00 ON G00.KOD=STOK29T.AMBCODE"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN KTA_S29T KTA ON KTA.KTA_KEY=STOK29T.SYSIRSALIYEPOSNO"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN GECOUST G ON G.EVRAKNO='!RED' AND G.KOD=KTA.SEBEP"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE G.AD_L2='K'"
	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND G00.GK_1 IN ('01','04')"
	Else
		QStr = QStr & " AND G00.GK_1='" & KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA & "'"
	End if
	QStr = QStr & " AND STOK29T.TARIH>='" & BaslangicTarihi & "' AND STOK29T.TARIH<='" & BitisTarihi & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " GROUP BY STOK29T.EVRAKNO"

	Set S29T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfsha", QStr)

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "19"
	if S29T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = S29T.GetRowCount()
	End if

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "20"
	if S29T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Round(Doc.Div(S29T.GetRowCount() * 1000, AGradeProduction) * 1000,2)
	End if


	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
		SaatlikMaliyet = 4.90
	Elseif trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "02" Then
		SaatlikMaliyet = 4.31
	End if
	KisiSayisi = 2
	KisiBasiCalismaSuresi = 2.5
	
	KaliteMaliyeti = S29T.GetRowCount() * SaatlikMaliyet * KisiSayisi * KisiBasiCalismaSuresi
	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "21"
	if S29T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = KaliteMaliyeti
	End if

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "22"
	if S29T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Round(Doc.Div(KaliteMaliyeti * 1000, AGradeProduction),2)
	End if

End Sub

Sub NoOfNewProductHesapla()
	Set KTT_INDIS0E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0E")
	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")
	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Yeni ürünler hesaplanýyor"

	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
		AdStr = " AND STOK00.AD IN ('SENKROLEN','EKOLEN')"
	Else
		AdStr = " AND STOK00.AD IN ('SENKROFIL','EKOFIL','SENKROFÝL','EKOFÝL')"
	End if

	QStr = "SELECT S40T.KOD, Sum(S40T.ONCEKI_MIKTAR) ONCEKI_MIKTAR, Sum(S40T.DONEM_MIKTAR) DONEM_MIKTAR"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM (SELECT STOK40T.KOD,"
	QStr = QStr & " (CASE WHEN STOK40T.TARIH<'" & BaslangicTarihi & "' THEN STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR ELSE 0 END) ONCEKI_MIKTAR,"
	QStr = QStr & " (CASE WHEN (STOK40T.TARIH>='" & BaslangicTarihi & "' AND STOK40T.TARIH<='" & BitisTarihi & "') THEN STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR ELSE 0 END) DONEM_MIKTAR"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK40T"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN STOK00 ON STOK00.KOD=STOK40T.KOD"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE STOK40T.GK_2 NOT IN ('NUMUNE','MONO')"
	QStr = QStr & AdStr
	QStr = QStr & " AND STOK40T.KOD NOT LIKE '99999%'"
	QStr = QStr & " ) S40T"
	QStr = QStr & " GROUP BY S40T.KOD"
	QStr = QStr & " HAVING Sum(S40T.ONCEKI_MIKTAR)=0 AND Sum(S40T.DONEM_MIKTAR)>0"

	SipAdet = 0
	Set S40T1 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sadfasdgfasdg", QStr)
	For i = 1 to S40T1.GetRowCount()
		QStr = "SELECT EVRAKNO, TARIH FROM STOK40T WHERE KOD='" & S40T1.KOD(i) & "' AND TARIH>='" & BaslangicTarihi & "' AND TARIH<='" & BitisTarihi & "'" & GK1Str & " AND GK_2<>'NUMUNE' ORDER BY TARIH"
		Set S40T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("xsdsefsg", QStr)
		If S40T.GetRowCount>0 Then 
			if Right(trim(S40T1.KOD(i)), 1) = "T" Then
				DigerKod = Left(S40T1.KOD(i), Len(trim(S40T1.KOD(i)))-1)
			Else
				DigerKod = trim(S40T1.KOD(i)) & "T"
			End if
			QStr = "SELECT EVRAKNO FROM STOK40T WHERE KOD='" & DigerKod & "' AND TARIH<'" & S40T.TARIH(1) & "'" & GK1Str & " AND GK_2<>'NUMUNE' ORDER BY TARIH"
			Set S40T12 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("xsdsefsgddd", QStr)
			if S40T12.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
				SipAdet = SipAdet + 1
			End if
		End if
	Next

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "25"
	KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = SipAdet

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "26"
	KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Round(Doc.Div(SipAdet, NoOfIncomingQueries) * 100,2)
End Sub
Sub AverageResponseTimeHesapla()
	Set KTT_INDIS0E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0E")
	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Average Response Time hesaplanýyor"

	QStr = "SELECT COUNT(*) ADET, SUM(TO_DATE(KTA.R_BITIS_T,'YYYY/MM/DD') - TO_DATE(KTA.R_GLS_TAR, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) SURE "
	QStr = QStr & " FROM KTA_STOK00 KTA"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE KTA.R_BITIS_T>='" & BaslangicTarihi & "' AND KTA.R_BITIS_T<='" & BitisTarihi & "'"
	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND KTA.KOD LIKE 'ARGE%'"
	Elseif trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "02" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND KTA.KOD LIKE 'Z-ARGE%'"
	End if
	QStr = QStr & " AND R_CLS_TURU NOT IN ('6','8')"

	Set KTA = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfsdfsj", QStr)

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "27"
	if KTA.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Round(Doc.Div(KTA.SURE(1), KTA.ADET(1)),2)
	End if
End Sub

Sub KazaRaporlariniHesapla()
	Set KTT_INDIS0E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0E")
	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Severity Index hesaplanýyor"	
	
	QStr = "SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN KAZANCKESINTIKODU='KIG08' THEN SURE_GUN ELSE 0 END) KAZA_ADEDI,"
	QStr = QStr & " SUM(CASE WHEN KAZANCKESINTIKODU='KIG09' THEN SURE_GUN ELSE 0 END) KAZA_SURESI,"
	QStr = QStr & " SUM(CASE WHEN KAZANCKESINTIKODU NOT IN ('KIG08', 'KIG09') THEN SURE_SAAT ELSE 0 END) ADAM_SAAT,"
	QStr = QStr & " SUM(CASE WHEN HESAPSABLONU='MAVÝ' AND KAZANCKESINTIKODU NOT IN ('KIG08', 'KIG09') AND KAZANCKESINTIKODU LIKE 'KI%' THEN SURE_SAAT ELSE 0 END) MAZERET_SAAT,"
'	QStr = QStr & " SUM(CASE WHEN HESAPSABLONU='MAVÝ' AND KAZANCKESINTIKODU NOT IN ('KIG08', 'KIG09') AND KAZANCKESINTIKODU LIKE 'KI%' THEN SURE_GUN ELSE 0 END) MAZERET_GUN,"
	QStr = QStr & " SUM(CASE WHEN HESAPSABLONU='MAVÝ' AND KAZANCKESINTIKODU NOT IN ('KIG08', 'KIG09') THEN SURE_SAAT ELSE 0 END) MAVI_ADAM_SAAT"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM BRDR1TP2"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE 1=1"
	QStr = QStr & " AND CTARIH1>='" & BaslangicTarihi & "' AND CTARIH1<='" & BitisTarihi & "'"
	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND KOD IN (SELECT KOD FROM PERSM0 WHERE GK_10 IN('01','04'))"
	Else
		QStr = QStr & " AND KOD IN (SELECT KOD FROM PERSM0 WHERE GK_10='" & KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA & "')"
	End if

	Set TP2 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfsdfsj", QStr)

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "30"
	if TP2.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Div(TP2.KAZA_ADEDI(1) * 1000000, TP2.ADAM_SAAT(1))
	End if

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "31"
	if TP2.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Div(TP2.KAZA_SURESI(1) * 1000, TP2.ADAM_SAAT(1))
	End if

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "32"
	if TP2.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		MazeretGun = Doc.Round(TP2.MAZERET_SAAT(1) / 7.5,2)
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = MazeretGun
	End if

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "33"
	if TP2.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
	
'		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Round(Doc.Div(TP2.MAZERET(1) * 1000, TP2.MAVI_ADAM_SAAT(1)),2)
'30.09.2013 Suat Bey'le telefon görüþmesi
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Round(Doc.Div(MazeretGun * 7.5, 1000),3)
	End if
End Sub
Sub SpesificEnergyHesapla()
	Set KTT_INDIS0E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0E")
	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Specific Energy hesaplanýyor"	

	QStr = "SELECT TARIH, Sum(BORCFIYAT) TUTAR, Sum(BORCMIKTAR) KWH"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM MUHA10T"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE 1=1"
	QStr = QStr & " AND BORCFIYAT>0"
	QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH>='" & BaslangicTarihi & "' AND TARIH<='" & BitisTarihi & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND KOD IN (SELECT KOD FROM MUHA00 WHERE GK_6='ELEK'"
	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
	  QStr = QStr & " AND GK_5='ISTB'"
	Elseif trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "02" Then
	  QStr = QStr & " AND GK_5='GANT'"
	End if
	QStr = QStr & " )"
	QStr = QStr & " GROUP BY TARIH"
	Set M10T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dsfgfsj", QStr)

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "34"
	if M10T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = M10T.SumOf("KWH")
	End if

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "35"
	if M10T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Round(Doc.Div(M10T.SumOf("KWH"), AGradeProduction),2)
	End if

	EURTutar = 0
	For i = 1 to M10T.GetRowCount()
		EURTutar = EURTutar + Doc.Round(Doc.Div(M10T.TUTAR(i), Doc.GetKurN("ECU", Doc.DefaultPB, M10T.TARIH(i), "", -1)),2) 
	Next

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "36"
	if M10T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = EURTutar
	End if

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "37"
	if M10T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Round(Doc.Div(EURTutar, AGradeProduction) * 1000,2)
	End if
End Sub
Sub ProdCostOku()
	Set KTT_INDIS0E = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0E")
	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")

	Doc.StatusBarMessage "Production Cost Okunuyor"	

	Firma = Doc.Getd7FirmCode()
	FirmaArr = Split(Firma, "_")
	if uBound(FirmaArr) <> "1" Then Exit Sub
	Yil = Doc.Cdbl(FirmaArr(1))
	if Yil<1994 or Yil>2050 Then Exit Sub

	DosyaAdi = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataRoot & "INDIS\" & Yil & " PROD COST.xls"
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	if not fso.FileExists(DosyaAdi) Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox DosyaAdi & " bulunamadý", "Production Cost Okunamadý", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if
	Set Excel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb1 = Excel.Workbooks.Open(DosyaAdi, False, True)
	Set Sh1 = Wb1.Sheets(KTT_INDIS0E.AY)
	'ProductionCost = 0
	if trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "01" Then
		ProductionCost = Sh1.Range("R6").Value
	Elseif trim(KTT_INDIS0E.FABRIKA) = "02" Then
		ProductionCost = Sh1.Range("R5").Value
	End if
	If Excel.IsError(ProductionCost) Then
		ProductionCost = 0
	Else
		ProductionCost = Doc.CDbl(ProductionCost)
	End if
	
	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "38"
	KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Round(ProductionCost,2)

	satirNo = KTT_INDIS0T.AddRow
	KTT_INDIS0T.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
	KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU = "39"
	KTT_INDIS0T.D_VALUE = Doc.Round(Doc.Div(Doc.Round(ProductionCost,2), AGradeProduction) * 1000,2)

	Wb1.Close
	Excel.Quit
End Sub
Sub cmdSuz()
	Set LISTEE = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTEE")
	Set LISTET = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")

	QStr1 = GetLISTETQStr1()
	QStr = QStr1 & " WHERE 1=1"
	QStr = QStr & " AND E.B_TARIH>='" & LISTEE.B_TARIH & "'"
	if trim(LISTEE.E_TARIH) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND E.B_TARIH<='" & LISTEE.E_TARIH & "'"
	End if
	QStr = QStr & " AND T.EVRAKNO>='" & LISTEE.B_EVRAKNO & "'"
	if trim(LISTEE.E_EVRAKNO) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr & " AND T.EVRAKNO<='" & LISTEE.E_EVRAKNO & "'"
	End if
	Set KT = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dfsdfhsj", QStr)
	LISTET.CopyTable(KT)
End Sub
Function GetNorDateStr(TarihFldName)
	GetNorDateStr = "TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(" & TarihFldName & ", 'YYYY/MM/DD'),'DD/MM/YYYY')"
End Function
Function GetLISTETQStr1()
	QStr1 = "SELECT T.EVRAKNO, E.YIL, E.AY, E.FABRIKA"
	QStr1 = QStr1 & " FROM KTT_INDIS0T T"
	QStr1 = QStr1 & " LEFT JOIN KTT_INDIS0E E ON E.EVRAKNO=T.EVRAKNO"
	GetLISTETQStr1 = QStr1
End Function
Sub INDISKODU_AV()
	Set KTT_INDIS0T = Doc.GetTableObject("KTT_INDIS0T")
	Set GT = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dfgdsfsj", "SELECT AD, AD_L2 FROM GECOUST WHERE EVRAKNO='!INDIS' AND KOD='" & KTT_INDIS0T.INDISKODU & "'")
	if GT.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		KTT_INDIS0T.INDISADI = GT.AD(1)
		KTT_INDIS0T.BIRIM = GT.AD_L2(1)
	End if
End Sub

Sub cmdDetayGosterMain()
	Set SPONAY_LIST = Doc.GetTableObject("SPONAY_LIST")
	if trim(SPONAY_LIST.SIP_IRS) = "Order" Then
		QStr = "SELECT S40T.KOD, STOK00.AD  KOD_STOK00_AD, SF_MIKTAR, S40T.SF_SF_UNIT,"
		QStr = QStr & " S40T.OR_FIYAT, S40T.OR_TUTAR, S40T.PRICEUNIT"
		QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK40T S40T"
		QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN STOK00 ON STOK00.KOD=S40T.KOD"
		QStr = QStr & "  WHERE S40T.EVRAKNO='" & Doc.RightJustify(trim(SPONAY_LIST.EVRAKNO),10) & "'"
	Else
		QStr = "SELECT S60T.KOD, STOK00.AD  KOD_STOK00_AD, S60T.SF_MIKTAR, S60T.SF_SF_UNIT,"
		QStr = QStr & " S40T.OR_FIYAT, S40T.OR_FIYAT * (S60T.SF_MIKTAR - S60T.SF_FATURALANANMIKTAR) OR_TUTAR, S40T.PRICEUNIT"
		QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK60T S60T"
		QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN STOK40T S40T ON S40T.ARTNO=S60T.SIPARTNO"
		QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN STOK00 ON STOK00.KOD=S40T.KOD"
		QStr = QStr & " WHERE S60T.EVRAKNO='" & Doc.RightJustify(trim(SPONAY_LIST.EVRAKNO),10) & "'"
	End if

	Set S40T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("SP_DETAY_LIST", QStr)

	Call GetCustomerInfo()
	S40T.SetRowAID 0,0,0
	Dim Par
	Set Par=Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "SIPARIS_DETAY",SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME,Par
End Sub
Sub cmdSecilenleriOnayla()
	Set Lst = Doc.Select2("dsfawdqweh", "SPONAY_LIST", "SELECTED='E'", "", -1)
	if Lst.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "No row selected", "Cancelled", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if

	if Doc.d7MsgBox("Are you sure you'd like to Authorize selected documents?", "Confirm", MB_YESNO) <> 6 Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "Cancelled", "", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if
	Set Lst1 = Doc.Select2("asdgdfhs", Lst.GetAppName, "SIP_IRS='Order'", "", -1)
	if Lst1.GetRowCount() > 0 Then Call SiparisOnayla(Lst1)

	Set Lst1 = Doc.Select2("asdgdfhs", Lst.GetAppName, "SIP_IRS='Delivery Note'", "", -1)
	if Lst1.GetRowCount() > 0 Then Call IrsaliyeOnayla(Lst1)
End Sub
Sub SiparisOnayla(Lst)
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK40", "")
	Set S40E = Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK40E")		
	Set S40T = Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK40T")		

	For i = 1 to Lst.GetRowCount()
		Call KilitCoz("STOK40E", Lst.EVRAKNO(i))
		Doc1.Load_Voucher Lst.EVRAKNO(i)
		if Doc1.IsLastLoadReadOnly() Then
			Doc.d7MsgBox "Order  No : " & trim(Lst.EVRAKNO(i)) & " hasn't been saved.", "", MB_OK
		Else
			if trim(S40E.ONAY_SONVERILENNO) <> trim(Lst.ONAY_SONVERILENNO(i)) Then
				Doc.d7MsgBox "Order  No : " & trim(Lst.EVRAKNO(i)) & " has been authorized before. Press pending orders again.", "", MB_OK
			Else
				Do 
					BeklenenOnay = Doc.Int(S40E.ONAY_BEKLENENNO)
					if Not (BeklenenOnay >= 1 and BeklenenOnay <= 5) Then Exit Do
					if OnayYetkisiVar("STOK40", CStr(BeklenenOnay)) Then
						Doc1.RunCommand "MT_DO_ONAYLA_EKINFO"
						S40E.KTA_ONAY_TUTAR = S40T.SumOf("TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR")
					Else
						Exit Do
					End if
				Loop
				if Doc1.Save_Voucher = 0 Then
					Lst.SELECTED(i) = "H"
				End if
			End if
		End if
		Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
	Next
	Call SiparisOnayMailGonder(Lst, "1")
End Sub
Sub IrsaliyeOnayla(Lst)
	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK60", "")
	Set S60E = Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK60E")		
	Set S60T = Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK60T")		
	'Doc.ShowTableDynForm2 Lst.GetAppName, "EVRAKNO,ONAY_SONVERILENNO"

	For i = 1 to Lst.GetRowCount()
		Call KilitCoz("STOK60E", Lst.EVRAKNO(i))
		Doc1.Load_Voucher Lst.EVRAKNO(i)
		if Doc1.IsLastLoadReadOnly() Then
			Doc.d7MsgBox "Delivery Note : " & trim(Lst.EVRAKNO(i)) & " hasn't been saved.", "", MB_OK
		Else
			if trim(S60E.ONAY_SONVERILENNO) <> trim(Lst.ONAY_SONVERILENNO(i)) Then
				Doc.d7MsgBox "Delivery Note : " & trim(Lst.EVRAKNO(i)) & " has been authorized before. Press pending documents again.", "", MB_OK
			Else
				Do 
					BeklenenOnay = Doc.Int(S60E.ONAY_BEKLENENNO)
					if Not (BeklenenOnay >= 1 and BeklenenOnay <= 5) Then Exit Do
					if OnayYetkisiVar("STOK60", CStr(BeklenenOnay)) Then
						Doc1.RunCommand "MT_DO_ONAYLA_EKINFO"
						S60E.KTA_ONAY_TUTAR = Lst.TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR(i)
					Else
						Exit Do
					End if
				Loop
				if Doc1.Save_Voucher = 0 Then
					Lst.SELECTED(i) = "H"
				End if
			End if
		End if
		Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
	Next
	Call IrsaliyeOnayMailGonder(Lst, "1")
End Sub

Function GetQStr()
	OnayBaslangicTarihi = GetOnayBaslangicTarihi
	QStr = " SELECT 'H' SELECTED, CAST('Order' AS CHAR(16)) SIP_IRS, E.EVRAKNO, E.TARIH, E.MUSTERIKODU, C.AD MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_AD, E.ODEMEGUNU, T.TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR, "
	QStr = QStr & " (CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(KTA.RED_TARIH,' ')) IS NOT NULL THEN 'E' ELSE ' ' END) REDDEDILDI, E.ONAY_SONVERILENNO"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK40E E"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN CARI00 C ON C.KOD=E.MUSTERIKODU"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN KTA_S40E KTA ON KTA.EVRAKNO=E.EVRAKNO"
	QStr = QStr & " INNER JOIN (SELECT EVRAKNO, Sum(TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR) TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR"
	QStr = QStr & "   FROM STOK40T"
	QStr = QStr & "   WHERE ACIKKAPALI=' '"
	QStr = QStr & "   GROUP BY EVRAKNO"
	QStr = QStr & " ) T ON T.EVRAKNO=E.EVRAKNO"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE ONAY_SONVERILENNO<>'5'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH>='" & OnayBaslangicTarihi & "'"

	GetQStr = QStr
End Function
Function GetIrsQStr()
	OnayBaslangicTarihi = GetOnayBaslangicTarihi
	QStr = "SELECT 'H' SELECTED, CAST('Delivery Note' AS CHAR(16))SIP_IRS, E.EVRAKNO, E.TARIH, E.CH_KODU, C.AD MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_AD, 0 ODEMEGUNU, 0 TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR, "
	QStr = QStr & " (CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(KTA.RED_TARIH,' ')) IS NOT NULL THEN 'E' ELSE ' ' END) REDDEDILDI, E.ONAY_SONVERILENNO"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK60E E"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN CARI00 C ON C.KOD=E.CH_KODU"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN KTA_S60E KTA ON KTA.EVRAKNO=E.EVRAKNO"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE E.ONAY_SONVERILENNO<>'5'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND E.TARIH>='" & OnayBaslangicTarihi & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND E.ELOG_APP='STOK60'"
	GetIrsQStr = QStr
End Function

Sub OnaylanacaklarListesiniGetir()
	QStr = GetQStr
	Set SPONAY_LIST = Doc.GetTableObject("SPONAY_LIST")
	Set S40E = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dfgewrtuw6gfh", QStr)
	Set S60E = Doc.RunSQLQuery("ddwefwfgewrtuw6gfh", GetIrsQStr)
	Call CalcIrsTutar(S60E)

	SPONAY_LIST.SetRowAID 1,1,1
	SPONAY_LIST.Empty

	SPONAY_LIST.AppendTable(S40E)
	SPONAY_LIST.AppendTable(S60E)

	SPONAY_LIST.SetFieldToDate("TARIH") 
	SPONAY_LIST.Sort("TARIH+EVRAKNO")
	SPONAY_LIST.SetRowAID 0,0,0
	
	SPONAY_LIST.SetFieldToDate("TARIH")
	Call F2Degistir(SPONAY_LIST.GetAppName, "MUSTERIKODU", "CARI00")
End Sub
Sub F2Degistir(TabloStr, AlanAdi, ByVal BrwTable)
	BrwTable = "'" & BrwTable & "'"
	Set tbl = Doc.GetTableObject(TabloStr)
	Set fd = tbl.GetFieldDef_E(AlanAdi)
	fd.F2Fnc = "DO_BRW(" & Replace(BrwTable,"'", """") & ")"
	tbl.SetFieldProperties1 AlanAdi,fd
End Sub
Function OnayYetkisiVar(DocType, OnayNo)
	OnayYetkisiVar = False
	QStr = "SELECT ONAY_" & OnayNo
	QStr = QStr & " FROM UDEFT9 UT9"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE UT9.KOD='" & Doc.Getd7UserName & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND UT9.PROGRAMKODU='" &  DocType & "'"
	Set UT9 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sadfsefhsj", QStr)
	if UT9.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Function
	if UT9.GetFieldValue("ONAY_" & OnayNo, 1) = "1" Then
		OnayYetkisiVar = True
	End if
End Function
Sub SiparisOnayMailGonder(Lst, OnayRed)
	Set Lst1 = Doc.Select2("dfsag55847ag", Lst.GetAppName, "SELECTED='H'", "", -1) 'kaydedilen sipariþlerin SELECTED 'larý H 'ye dönüþmüþtü
	if Lst1.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub

	QStr = "SELECT E.EVRAKNO, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(E.TARIH,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'DD/MM/YYYY') TARIH, C.AD MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_AD, "
	QStr = QStr & " E.BOWNER_USERNAME, U.EMAIL "
	QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK40E E"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN CARI00 C ON C.KOD=E.MUSTERIKODU"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN UDEF U ON U.KOD=E.BOWNER_USERNAME"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE E.EVRAKNO IN ("	
	For i = 1 to Lst1.GetRowCount()
		if i > 1 Then QStr = QStr & ","
		QStr = QStr & "'" & Doc.RightJustify(trim(Lst1.EVRAKNO(i)), 10) & "'"
	Next
	QStr = QStr & " )"
	QStr = QStr & " ORDER BY E.BOWNER_USERNAME, E.EVRAKNO"
	Set S40E = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfsada", QStr)
'set ggg = Doc.CreateSObject("BAtCHERRORMODE")
	Set S40E1 = Doc.Select2("adsfasdgha", S40E.GetAppName, "", "", -1)
	S40E1.GroupBy2("BOWNER_USERNAME")

	if OnayRed = "1" Then
		OnayRedStr = "Onaylanan"
	Elseif OnayRed = "0" Then
		OnayRedStr = "Reddedilen"
	End if
	For i = 1 to S40E1.GetRowCount()
		if trim(S40E1.EMAIL(i)) <> "" Then
			Set S40E2 = Doc.Select2("asfsaah", S40E.GetAppName, "BOWNER_USERNAME='" & S40E1.BOWNER_USERNAME(i) & "'", "", -1)
			HTMLBaslik = OnayRedStr & " Sipariþler : "
			TabloBaslikArray = Array("Sipariþ No", "Tarih", "Müþteri")
			AlanArr = Array("EVRAKNO","TARIH","MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_AD")
			HtmlTable = Doc.RunMacro4("MAKR7S.FREEMAIL", "GetTableHTML2", S40E2, HTMLBaslik, TabloBaslikArray, AlanArr)

			strTo = trim(S40E1.EMAIL(i)) & ";a.rossetos@senkroma.com.tr,s.cetin@senkroma.com.tr"
			strHeader = "Sipariþ Onay"
			strMsg = HtmlTable
			DosyaAdi = ""
			Doc.RunMacro4 "MAKR7S.FREEMAIL", "SendMail", strTo,strHeader,strMsg,DosyaAdi
		Else
			Doc.d7MsgBox "Kullanýcý tanýmlarýnda " & trim(S40E1.BOWNER_USERNAME(i)) & " kullanýcýsýna ait mail adresi girilmemiþ", "", MB_OK
		End if
	Next
End Sub

Function GetOnayBaslangicTarihi()
	GetOnayBaslangicTarihi = ""
	Set d7Date = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	LimitOnayBaslangicTarihi = Doc.Customp_Gets("!LMTONT")
	if trim(LimitOnayBaslangicTarihi) = "" Then Exit Function
	
	d7Date.SetDate(trim(LimitOnayBaslangicTarihi))
	if Not d7Date.IsValid Then Exit Function

	GetOnayBaslangicTarihi = d7Date.GetRevDate
End Function
Function GetIrsaliyeKDVDahilTutar(EvrakNo)
	GetIrsaliyeKDVDahilTutar = 0
	QStr = "SELECT EVRAKNO, CH_KODU, KOD, Sum(SF_MIKTAR) SF_MIKTAR, Sum(SF_FATURALANANMIKTAR) SF_FATURALANANMIKTAR, SIPARTNO, "
	QStr = QStr & " Sum(TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR) TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK60T"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE EVRAKNO='" & EvrakNo & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " GROUP BY EVRAKNO, CH_KODU, KOD, SIPARTNO"
	Set S60T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfadqhr", QStr)
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRowCount()
		GetIrsaliyeKDVDahilTutar = GetIrsaliyeKDVDahilTutar + GetIrsaliyeTutari(S60T, i)
	Next
End Function
Function GetIrsaliyeTutari(S60, satirNo)
	GetIrsaliyeTutari = 0
	if S60.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo) <> 0 then
		FaturalanacakMiktar = S60.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo) - S60.SF_FATURALANANMIKTAR(satirNo)
		if S60.TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR(satirNo) = 0 then
			SiparisNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T","EVRAKNO", S60.SIPARTNO(satirNo), "ARTNO")
			MuhtemelNitelik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","MUHT_FATURA_NITELIK", SiparisNo,"")
			KurAktarma = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","KURKESINLESTIRME", SiparisNo,"")
			SiparisMiktari = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T","SF_MIKTAR", S60.SIPARTNO(satirNo),"ARTNO")
			KDVHaricTutar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T","OR_IVD_KH_TUTAR", S60.SIPARTNO(satirNo),"ARTNO")
			KDVTutari = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T","OR_KDVTUT_EFEKTIF", S60.SIPARTNO(satirNo),"ARTNO")
				If MuhtemelNitelik = "XK" Then
				SiparisTutari = KDVHaricTutar + KDVTutari
			Else
				SiparisTutari = KDVHaricTutar
			End If
			SiparisPB = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T","PRICEUNIT",S60.SIPARTNO(satirNo),"ARTNO")

			SiparisFiyati = Doc.Div(SiparisTutari, SiparisMiktari)
			if KurAktarma = "E" then
				KurDegeri = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T","KUR",S60.SIPARTNO(satirNo),"ARTNO")
			Else
				KurDegeri = Doc.GetKurN(SiparisPB, Doc.DefaultPB, Doc.BuGun, "", -1)
			End if
			GetIrsaliyeTutari = SiparisFiyati * KurDegeri * FaturalanacakMiktar
		else
			GetIrsaliyeTutari = Doc.Div(S60.TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR(satirNo) * FaturalanacakMiktar, S60.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo))
		end if
	end if
End Function
Sub CalcIrsTutar(S60E)
	For i = 1 to S60E.GetRowCount()
		S60E.TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR(i) = GetIrsaliyeKDVDahilTutar(S60E.EVRAKNO(i))
		S60E.ODEMEGUNU(i) = GetSipOdemeGunu(S60E.EVRAKNO(i))
	Next
End Sub
Function GetSipOdemeGunu(IrsaliyeNo)
	GetSipOdemeGunu = ""
	QStr = "SELECT DISTINCT S40E.ODEMEGUNU"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK60T S60T"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN STOK40E S40E ON S40E.EVRAKNO=S60T.SIPNO"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE S60T.EVRAKNO='" & Doc.RightJustify(trim(IrsaliyeNo), 10) & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND TRIM(S60T.SIPNO) IS NOT NULL"
	QStr = QStr & " ORDER BY S40E.ODEMEGUNU DESC"
	Set S60T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("asdfaga", QStr)

	if S60T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		GetSipOdemeGunu = S60T.ODEMEGUNU(1)
	End if
End Function
Sub GetCustomerInfo()
	Set MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE")
	Set SP = Doc.GetTableObject("SPONAY_LIST")

	Set C00 = Doc.Select1("Cwergw4", "CARI00", "KOD='" & SP.MUSTERIKODU & "'", "", -1)
	'if C00.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub

	AcikHesapLimiti = C00.B_ACIKHESAPLIMITI
	RiskLimiti = C00.B_RISKLIMITI

	MTable.CH_KODU = C00.KOD
	MTable.CH_KODU_CARI00_AD = C00.AD
	MTable.RISK_LIMITI = RiskLimiti

	CSRisk = Doc.CSRisk_Toplam("",CHKodu,"","")
	BorcBakiyesi = Doc.CariHesapToplamlariBA(CHKodu,"BB")
	ToplamIrsaliyeTutari = GetIrsaliyeRiski(C00.KOD) + BuIrsaliyeRiski
	SevkEmriRiski = CalculateSevkRisk(C00.KOD)
	
	ToplamAcikHesap = BorcBakiyesi + ToplamIrsaliyeTutari
	ToplamSiparisTutari = GetSiparisTutari(C00.KOD)
	ToplamCHRisk = CSRisk + ToplamAcikHesap
	ToplamRisk = ToplamCHRisk + ToplamSiparisTutari + SevkEmriRiski
	
	MTable.BORC_BAKIYESI = BorcBakiyesi
	MTable.SIP_RISKI = ToplamSiparisTutari
	MTable.IRS_RISKI = ToplamIrsaliyeTutari
	MTable.CS_RISKI = CSRisk
	MTable.TOPLAM_RISK = ToplamRisk

End Sub
Function GetSiparisTutari(CHKodu)
	GetSiparisTutari = 0
	QStr = "SELECT T.EVRAKNO, T.PRICEUNIT, Sum(T.OR_IVD_KH_TUTAR) OR_IVD_KH_TUTAR, Sum(T.OR_KDVTUT_EFEKTIF) OR_KDVTUT_EFEKTIF, "
	QStr = QStr & " E.MUHT_FATURA_NITELIK, E.KURKESINLESTIRME, Sum(T.SF_MIKTAR - T.SF_NETKAPANANMIK) SIP_BAKIYE,  Sum(T.SF_MIKTAR) SF_MIKTAR"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK40T T"
	QStr = QStr & " LEFT JOIN STOK40E E ON T.EVRAKNO=E.EVRAKNO"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE T.MUSTERIKODU='" & CHKodu & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND T.ACIKKAPALI=' '"
	QStr = QStr & " AND T.SF_MIKTAR > T.SF_NETKAPANANMIK"
	QStr = QStr & " GROUP BY T.EVRAKNO, T.PRICEUNIT, T.KOD, E.MUHT_FATURA_NITELIK, E.KURKESINLESTIRME"
	Set T_STOK40T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("XXX", QStr)

	for i = 1 to T_STOK40T.GetRecCount()
		MuhtemelNitelik = T_STOK40T.MUHT_FATURA_NITELIK(i)
		KurKesinlestirme = T_STOK40T.KURKESINLESTIRME(i)
		If trim(MuhtemelNitelik) = "XK" Then
			SiparisTutari = T_STOK40T.OR_IVD_KH_TUTAR(i)
		Else
			SiparisTutari = T_STOK40T.OR_IVD_KH_TUTAR(i) + T_STOK40T.OR_KDVTUT_EFEKTIF(i)
		End If

		SiparisFiyati = doc.Div(SiparisTutari, T_STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(i))
		If trim(KurKesinlestirme) = "E" Then
			KurDegeri = T_STOK40T.KUR(i)
		Else
			KurDegeri = Doc.GetKurN(T_STOK40T.PRICEUNIT(i), Doc.DefaultPB, Doc.BuGun, "", -1)
		End If
		GetSiparisTutari = GetSiparisTutari + SiparisFiyati * KurDegeri * T_STOK40T.SIP_BAKIYE(i)
	Next
End Function
Function CalculateSevkRisk(CHKodu)
	CalculateSevkRisk = 0 'initiate the return value
	SiparisTutari = 0
	SevkQStr = "SELECT STOK40T.MUSTERIKODU Musteri, STOK01.SF_MIKTAR SevkMik, STOK40T.PRICEUNIT ParaBirimi, " & vbCr & _
		"STOK40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR IskontoluTutar, STOK40T.OR_KDVTUT_EFEKTIF KDVTutar, " & vbCr & _
		"STOK40T.KUR DovizKur, STOK01.ALLOC_SIPNO SiparisNo, STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR SiparisMik " & vbCr & _
		"FROM STOK01, STOK40T " & vbCr & _
		"WHERE (STOK01.ALLOC_SIPARTNO = STOK40T.ARTNO) AND (STOK01.ALLOC_EVRAKTYPE = 'SV') AND (STOK40T.MUSTERIKODU = '" & CHKodu & "')"
		
	Set S01 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("SevkQuery", SevkQStr)
	For i = 1 To S01.GetRecCount()
		MuhtemelNitelik = doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E", "MUHT_FATURA_NITELIK", S01.SiparisNo(i), "")
		KurAktarma = doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK40E", "KURKESINLESTIRME", S01.SiparisNo(i), "")
		SiparisPB = S01.ParaBirimi(i)
		KDVHaricTutar = S01.IskontoluTutar(i)
		KDVTatari = S01.KDVTutar(i)
	
		If MuhtemelNitelik = "XK" Then
			SiparisTutari = KDVHaricTutar + KDVTutari
		Else
			SiparisTutari = KDVHaricTutar
		End If
		SiparisFiyati = doc.Div(SiparisTutari, S01.SiparisMik(i))
		If KurAktarma = "E" Then
			KurDegeri = S01.DovizKur(i)
		Else
			KurDegeri = doc.GetKurN(SiparisPB, doc.defaultpb, doc.Bugun, "", -1)
		End If
		CalculateSevkRisk = CalculateSevkRisk + SiparisFiyati * KurDegeri * S01.SevkMik(i)
	Next
End Function
Function GetIrsaliyeRiski(CHKodu)
	GetIrsaliyeRiski = 0
	QStr = "SELECT (STOK60T.SF_MIKTAR - STOK60T.SF_FATURALANANMIKTAR) MIKTAR, STOK40E.MUHT_FATURA_NITELIK, STOK40E.KURKESINLESTIRME,"
	QStr = QStr & " (STOK40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR + STOK40T.OR_KDVTUT_EFEKTIF) SIP_KDV_DAHIL_TUTAR, STOK40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR SIP_TUTAR, STOK40T.KUR SIP_KUR, " 
	QStr = QStr & " STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR SIP_MIKTAR, STOK40T.PRICEUNIT SIP_PB "
	QStr = QStr & " FROM STOK60T"
	QStr = QStr & " INNER JOIN STOK40T ON STOK60T.SIPARTNO=STOK40T.ARTNO"
	QStr = QStr & " INNER JOIN STOK40E ON STOK60T.SIPNO=STOK40E.EVRAKNO"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE STOK60T.CH_KODU='" & CHKodu & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND STOK60T.SF_MIKTAR > STOK60T.SF_FATURALANANMIKTAR"
	Set S60T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("aef23g", QStr)
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRowCount()
		If trim(S60T.MUHT_FATURA_NITELIK(i)) = "XK" Then
			SiparisTutari = S60T.SIP_TUTAR(i)
		Else
			SiparisTutari = S60T.SIP_KDV_DAHIL_TUTAR(i)
		End If

		SiparisFiyati = doc.Div(SiparisTutari, S60T.SIP_MIKTAR(i))
		If trim(S60T.KURKESINLESTIRME(i)) = "E" Then
			KurDegeri = S60T.SIP_KUR(i)
		Else
			KurDegeri = Doc.GetKurN(S60T.SIP_PB(i), Doc.DefaultPB, Doc.BuGun, "", -1)
		End If
		GetIrsaliyeRiski = GetIrsaliyeRiski + SiparisFiyati * KurDegeri * S60T.MIKTAR(i)
	Next
End Function
Sub DigerRiskBilgileriniYaz()

	QStr = "SELECT ILGILI_CHKODU, AD, B_RISKLIMITI FROM CARI00 WHERE KOD='" & STOK60E.CH_KODU & "'"
	Set C00 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("asdfqwgqwrgdsf", QStr)
	Limit = C00.B_RISKLIMITI
	ToplamRisk = BorcBakiyesi + CSRisk + ToplamIrsaliyeTutari + ToplamSiparisTutari
	ToplamRisk2 = BorcBakiyesi + CSRisk + ToplamIrsaliyeTutari
	
	CekRiskOrani = Doc.Round(Doc.Div(CSRisk, ToplamRisk) * 100, 1)
	CekRiskOrani2 = Doc.Round(Doc.Div(CSRisk, ToplamRisk2) * 100, 1)
	Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Delivery Note No", trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO))
	Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Customer", trim(C00.AD))
	Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Current balance", Doc.NumFormat0(BorcBakiyesi, 12,2) & " " & Doc.DefaultPB())
	Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Post Dated Cheques/Notes", Doc.NumFormat0(CSRisk, 12,2) & " " & Doc.DefaultPB())
	Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Delivery Notes Not Invoiced", Doc.NumFormat0(ToplamIrsaliyeTutari, 12,2) & " " & Doc.DefaultPB())
	Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Open Orders", Doc.NumFormat0(ToplamSiparisTutari, 12,2) & " " & Doc.DefaultPB())
	Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Total Risk", Doc.NumFormat0(ToplamRisk, 12,2) & " " & Doc.DefaultPB())
	Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Credit limit ", Doc.NumFormat0(Limit, 12,2) & " " & Doc.DefaultPB())
	Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Percentage coverage of " & vbcrlf & "Total Risk by cheques ", CekRiskOrani & " %")
	Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Percentage coverage of " & vbcrlf & "Total Risk (w/o open orders) by cheques", CekRiskOrani2 & " %")

	Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "The previous collection made	:", "")
	Call GeCustomerLastCollectionInfo(STOK60E.CH_KODU, IslemTarihi, Tutar, OrtalamaValorTarihi)	
	if trim(IslemTarihi) <> "" Then
		Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "    Collection Date", Doc.StrToNorDate(IslemTarihi))
		Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "    Collected Amount", Doc.NumFormat0(Tutar, 12,2) & " " & Doc.DefaultPB())
		Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "    Average Due Date", Doc.StrToNorDate(OrtalamaValorTarihi))
	Else
		Call TblAdd(Tbl1, chr(9) & "Collection Date", "")
		Call TblAdd(Tbl1, chr(9) & "Collected Amount", "")
		Call TblAdd(Tbl1, chr(9) & "Average Due Date", "")
	End if
	
	if trim(C00.ILGILI_CHKODU) <> "" Then
		Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Group Company : ", trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", C00.ILGILI_CHKODU, "")))

		Call GetGroupCompanyInfo(C00.ILGILI_CHKODU, GrupLimiti, ToplamGrupRiski)
		Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Group Credit Limit : ", Doc.NumFormat(GrupLimiti, 12,2) & " " & Doc.DefaultPB())
		Call TblAdd(Tbl1, "Group Total Risk : ", Doc.NumFormat(ToplamGrupRiski + ToplamRisk, 12,2) & " " & Doc.DefaultPB())
	End if
	strTo = "h.yazir@senkroma.com.tr;a.rossetos@senkroma.com.tr,s.cetin@senkroma.com.tr"
	if Doc.Getd7UserName = "FX" Then strTo = "cengizucar@temelteknoloji.com"
	strHeader = "Credit Limit Override (Delivery Note)"
	DosyaAdi = ""
	HTMLBaslik = ""
	TabloBaslikArray = Array("", "")
	HTMLMsg = Doc.RunMacro3("MAKR7S.FREEMAIL", "GetTableHTML", Tbl1, HTMLBaslik, TabloBaslikArray)
	Doc.RunMacro4 "MAKR7S.FREEMAIL", "SendMail", strTo,strHeader,HTMLMsg,DosyaAdi
End Sub
Sub TblAdd(Tbl1, Par, Deger)
	satirNo = Tbl1.AddRow
	Tbl1.BASLIK(satirNo) = Par
	Tbl1.DEGER(satirNo) = Deger
End Sub
Sub GeCustomerLastCollectionInfo(CHKodu, IslemTarihi, Tutar, OrtalamaValorTarihi)
	IslemTarihi = ""
	Tutar = 0
	OrtalamaValorTarihi = ""
	QStr = "SELECT TARIH, SUM(ALACAKFIYAT) ALACAKFIYAT, "
	QStr = QStr & " TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ROUND(Sum(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(VALORTARIH,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'J')) * ALACAKFIYAT) / Sum(ALACAKFIYAT),0), 'J'),'YYYY/MM/DD') ORT_VALOR"
	QStr = QStr & " FROM CARI10T"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE KOD='" & CHKodu & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND ALACAKFIYAT>0"
	QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH = ("
	QStr = QStr & " 	SELECT MAX(TARIH) FROM CARI10T WHERE KOD='" & CHKodu & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " 	AND ALACAKFIYAT>0"
	QStr = QStr & " )"
	QStr = QStr & " GROUP BY TARIH"
	Set C10T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sadfasdah", QStr)
	if C10T.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub

	IslemTarihi = C10T.TARIH
	Tutar = C10T.ALACAKFIYAT
	OrtalamaValorTarihi = C10T.ORT_VALOR
End Sub
Sub GetGroupCompanyInfo(IlgiliCHKodu, GrupLimiti, ToplamGrupRiski)
	GrupLimiti = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "B_RISKLIMITI", C00.ILGILI_CHKODU, "")
	ToplamGrupRiski = 0

	Set C00 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("sdfasdga", "SELECT KOD FROM CARI00 WHERE ILGILI_CHKODU='" & C00.ILGILI_CHKODU & "' AND KOD<>'" & STOK60E.CH_KODU & "'")
	For i = 1 to C00.GetRowCount()
		ToplamGrupRiski = ToplamGrupRiski + Doc.CariHesapToplamlariBA(C00.KOD(i),"BB") + Doc.CSRisk_Toplam("",C00.KOD(i),"","") + _
					GetSiparisTutari(C00.KOD(i)) + GetIrsaliyeRiski(C00.KOD(i)) + CalculateSevkRisk(C00.KOD(i))
	Next
End Sub
Sub KilitCoz(ByVal EvrakType, ByVal EvrakNo)
	EvrakNo = Doc.RightJustify(trim(EvrakNo), 50)
	QStr = "DELETE FROM D7WLOCK WHERE EVRAKTYPE='" & EvrakType & "' AND EVRAKNO='" & EvrakNo & "'"
	Set gg = Doc.RunMacro1("MAKR7S.SQL", "RunSQLQuery2", QStr)
End Sub

Sub Makro1
  Set MTable=Doc.CreateTableObject("MAKROTABLE=STACK","IO")
	MTable.Addfield2 "PARCARESMI_1","CHAR",256,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "PARCARESMI_2","CHAR",256,0,"L","",""
	MTable.Addfield2 "PARCARESMI_3","CHAR",256,0,"L","",""
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub ResimTazele
	Set S60T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T") 
	S60T.SORT("KOD")
	Set MTABLE_STOKOP = Doc.GetTableObject("MAKROTABLE") 
	
	StokKodu = S60T.KOD
	RESIM1	= Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", StokKodu+"000001", "EVRAKNO+SUBSRNUM"))
	RESIM2	= Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", StokKodu+"000002", "EVRAKNO+SUBSRNUM"))

	MTABLE_STOKOP.PARCARESMI_1 = RESIM1
	MTABLE_STOKOP.PARCARESMI_2 = RESIM2

	Doc.RunCommand "CMD_OZET3"
End Sub

Sub CariYaz(CariKodu)
	Set S60E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60E")
	Set S60T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T")
	
	EvrakNo = Trim(S60E.EVRAKNO)

	If EvrakNo = "" Then
		ret = Doc.New_Voucher
		S60E.AMBCODE = "MA"
		S60E.RSEVKTARIH = S60E.TARIH
		S60E.RSEVKSAAT = Doc.Saat(5)
	End If

	S60E.CH_KODU = CariKodu 
	Doc.CallFieldAfterValidate_Row "STOK60E", "CH_KODU", -1
		
	S60T.Empty
	If CariKodu <> "120-01-001" Then
		S60E.SHIPTOCODE = ""
		S60E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1 = ""
		S60E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_2 = ""
		S60E.SEVKADRESI_1 = ""
		S60E.SEVKADRESI_2 = ""
		S60E.SEVKADRESI_3 = ""
	End If
End Sub
